    NULL AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    `cis_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
    `cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION` AS `SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION`,
    `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `ROWID`,
    NULL AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  WHERE COALESCE(`cis_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`, '') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    `drupal_course_catalog`.`SO_TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
    `drupal_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION` AS `SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION`,
    `drupal_course_catalog`.`SECTION_ID` AS `ROWID`,
    NULL AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
  WHERE COALESCE(`drupal_course_catalog`.`SO_TERM_CODE`, '') <> ''
)
SELECT
  atr.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  atr.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  atr.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  -- number of distinct TIP subject types for the term: distinct SUBJECT_TITLE for TIP-marked rows
  COALESCE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN (
        (ccr.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.SUBJECT_TITLE) LIKE '%tip%')
        OR (ccr.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE) LIKE '%tip%')
        OR (ccr.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.DEPARTMENT_CODE) LIKE '%tip%')
        OR (ccr.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%tip%')
      ) THEN ccr.SUBJECT_TITLE
      ELSE NULL
    END), 0) AS TIP_SUBJECT_TYPE_COUNT,
  -- number of distinct 'materials needed' values (use SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION) for TIP subjects
  COALESCE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN (
        (ccr.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.SUBJECT_TITLE) LIKE '%tip%')
        OR (ccr.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE) LIKE '%tip%')
        OR (ccr.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.DEPARTMENT_CODE) LIKE '%tip%')
        OR (ccr.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(ccr.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%tip%')
      ) THEN NULLIF(TRIM(ccr.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION), '')
      ELSE NULL
    END), 0) AS MATERIALS_NEEDED_COUNT,
  -- enrollment min/max: schema has no consistent enrollment field so these will be NULL (kept for completeness)
  MIN(ccr.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MIN_ENROLLED,
  MAX(ccr.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED,
  -- number of distinct schools/departments offering subjects that term (use DEPARTMENT_CODE)
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(ccr.DEPARTMENT_CODE), '')), 0) AS SCHOOL_COUNT,
  -- total number of catalog records for the term (from the combined catalog sources)
  COALESCE(COUNT(ccr.ROWID), 0) AS TOTAL_RECORDS_FOR_TERM
FROM academic_term_rows atr
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_rows_by_term ccr
  ON atr.TERM_CODE = ccr.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  atr.TERM_CODE,
  atr.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  atr.IS_CURRENT_TERM
ORDER BY atr.TERM_CODE

rows.question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_square_footage_measures AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    CAST(
      (COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0)
       + COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0))
      / NULLIF(
          ( (b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL) + (b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL) ),
          0
        )
      AS DECIMAL(18,2)
    ) AS AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM buildings b
),
building_addresses_street AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY,
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NAME) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL) ELSE '' END
    ) AS STREET_ADDRESS,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE
  FROM fac_building_address fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  bas.STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  bas.CITY AS CITY,
  bas.STATE AS STATE,
  fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  bsfm.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  bsfm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  bsfm.AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN building_square_footage_measures bsfm
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bsfm.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_addresses_street bas
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bas.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
  ON fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY -- placeholder to allow NULL HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME when no mapping exists
ORDER BY
  bsfm.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
  bsfm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
  bsfm.AVERAGE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC

rows.question: For the 2023 Fall term, what are the unique term descriptions, subject titles along with their prerequisites, total number of types of subjects per term code, instructor of this course, and the number of types of courses ever taught by the instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_descriptions AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` LIKE '2023FA%' OR `TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`, `TERM_DESCRIPTION`
),
-- Build canonical subject offerings joined to available course-catalog sources to ensure SUBJECT_TITLE or SUBJECT_CODE exists
subject_offerings_catalog AS (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE                                                     AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, cis.SUBJECT_CODE, drupal.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cis.SUBJECT_TITLE, drupal.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(ccso.PREREQUISITES, '')                                  AS PREREQUISITES,
    NULLIF(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, '')                           AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY                                     AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID
  FROM subject_offered AS so
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccso
    ON ccso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog AS cis
    ON cis.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS drupal
    ON drupal.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  -- Only keep rows that have either a SUBJECT_TITLE or SUBJECT_CODE coming from the catalog sources (per requirement)
  WHERE (ccso.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
         OR cis.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
         OR drupal.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
         OR so.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
         OR ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
         OR cis.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
         OR drupal.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL)
),
-- Count distinct subject types per TERM_CODE (per-term SUBJECT_CODE distinct count)
term_subject_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_PER_TERM_CODE
  FROM subject_offerings_catalog
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
-- For each instructor, total distinct SUBJECT_CODE across all terms (exclude null/empty names)
instructor_course_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS NUM_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES_TAUGHT_BY_INSTRUCTOR
  FROM subject_offerings_catalog
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
)
SELECT
  td.TERM_DESCRIPTION                             AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  soc.TERM_CODE                                   AS TERM_CODE,
  soc.SUBJECT_TITLE                                AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  soc.PREREQUISITES                                AS PREREQUISITES,
  soc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME                     AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  COALESCE(tc.NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_PER_TERM_CODE, 0)  AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_PER_TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(ic.NUM_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES_TAUGHT_BY_INSTRUCTOR, 0) AS NUM_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES_TAUGHT_BY_INSTRUCTOR
FROM term_descriptions td
JOIN subject_offerings_catalog soc
  ON soc.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
-- exclude rows with no instructor name per requirement
AND soc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN term_subject_type_counts tc
  ON tc.TERM_CODE = soc.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN instructor_course_type_counts ic
  ON ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = soc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
ORDER BY soc.TERM_CODE ASC, soc.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC

rows.question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the assignable floor area and building.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH occupying_organization_details AS (
  SELECT
    fo.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORG_KEY`,
    fo.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    fo.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` AS `ORG_NAME`
  FROM `fac_organization` fo
),
building_summary AS (
  SELECT
    fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_ID`,
    fb.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
    fb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS `BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT`
  FROM `fac_building` fb
  WHERE fb.`BUILDING_NAME` IS NOT NULL
),
floor_assignable_areas AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY`        AS `BUILDING_ID`,
    fr.`FLOOR`               AS `FLOOR_NUMBER`,
    SUM(IFNULL(fr.`AREA`, 0)) AS `FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT`
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  WHERE fr.`BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    fr.`FLOOR`
),
rooms_core AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`       AS `FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
    fr.`ROOM`               AS `ROOM_ID`,
    fr.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`     AS `ROOM_FULL_NAME`,
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY`       AS `BUILDING_ID`,
    fr.`FLOOR`              AS `FLOOR_NUMBER`,
    fr.`AREA`               AS `ROOM_AREA`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`   AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  WHERE fr.`ROOM` IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.`ROOM` <> ''
    AND fr.`BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  rc.`ROOM_FULL_NAME` AS room_full_name,
  bs.`BUILDING_NAME` AS building_name,
  rc.`FLOOR_NUMBER` AS floor_number,
  ood.`ORG_NAME` AS occupying_organization,
  ood.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS occupying_department,
  -- percentages: null when denominator is null or zero
  CASE
    WHEN rc.`ROOM_AREA` IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN fa.`FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT` IS NULL OR fa.`FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT` = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100 * rc.`ROOM_AREA` / fa.`FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT`, 4)
  END AS pct_of_floor_assignable_area,
  CASE
    WHEN rc.`ROOM_AREA` IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN bs.`BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT` IS NULL OR bs.`BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT` = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100 * rc.`ROOM_AREA` / bs.`BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT`, 6)
  END AS pct_of_building_assignable_area,
  -- include raw areas for reference
  rc.`ROOM_AREA` AS room_area_sqft,
  fa.`FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT` AS floor_assignable_sqft,
  bs.`BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_SQFT` AS building_assignable_sqft
FROM rooms_core rc
LEFT JOIN occupying_organization_details ood
  ON rc.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` = ood.`ORG_KEY`
LEFT JOIN floor_assignable_areas fa
  ON rc.`BUILDING_ID` = fa.`BUILDING_ID`
 AND (rc.`FLOOR_NUMBER` = fa.`FLOOR_NUMBER` OR (rc.`FLOOR_NUMBER` IS NULL AND fa.`FLOOR_NUMBER` IS NULL))
LEFT JOIN building_summary bs
  ON rc.`BUILDING_ID` = bs.`BUILDING_ID`
-- only include rows where building exists per requirement
WHERE bs.`BUILDING_NAME` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY bs.`BUILDING_NAME`, rc.`FLOOR_NUMBER`, rc.`ROOM_ID`

rows.question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the floor area and building.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_area_totals AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(fr.AREA) AS building_total_area
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
room_basic_info AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS room_key,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fr.FLOOR AS floor,
    fr.AREA AS room_area,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS occupying_organization,
    fr.DEPT_CODE AS occupying_department
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.AREA IS NOT NULL
),
floor_area_totals AS (
  SELECT
    building_key,
    floor,
    SUM(room_area) AS floor_total_area
  FROM room_basic_info
  GROUP BY building_key, floor
)
SELECT
  r.room_full_name AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  r.floor AS floor_number,
  r.occupying_organization AS occupying_organization,
  r.occupying_department AS occupying_department,
  CASE
    WHEN f.floor_total_area IS NULL OR f.floor_total_area = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (r.room_area / f.floor_total_area) * 100
  END AS pct_area_of_floor,
  CASE
    WHEN bt.building_total_area IS NULL OR bt.building_total_area = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (r.room_area / bt.building_total_area) * 100
  END AS pct_area_of_building
FROM room_basic_info r
JOIN buildings b
  ON r.building_key = b.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN floor_area_totals f
  ON r.building_key = f.building_key
  AND r.floor = f.floor
JOIN building_area_totals bt
  ON r.building_key = bt.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME, r.floor, r.room_full_name

rows.question: What are the academic year, and instructors names for courses offered in the academic year 2022, along with the total number of types of courses per instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH instructor_offering_flags_by_course AS (
  SELECT
    lc.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    csco.`SECTION_ID` AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    ccc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS COURSE_ID,
    -- prefer cis_course_catalog.ACADEMIC_YEAR if present, else course_catalog_subject_offered or drupal
    COALESCE(ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, csco.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    -- flags from cis_course_catalog (ccc), course_catalog_subject_offered (csco), or drupal (dc)
    ccc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM   AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    ccc.IS_OFFERED_IAP         AS IS_OFFERED_IAP,
    ccc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM,
    ccc.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM,
    csco.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM   AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM_1,
    csco.IS_OFFERED_IAP         AS IS_OFFERED_IAP_1,
    csco.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM_1,
    csco.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM_1,
    dc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM   AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM_2,
    dc.IS_OFFERED_IAP         AS IS_OFFERED_IAP_2,
    dc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM_2,
    dc.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM_2
  FROM library_course_instructor lc
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd
    ON lc.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered csco
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = csco.TERM_CODE
    AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = csco.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER = csco.SUBJECT_NUMBER
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog ccc
    ON csco.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dc
    ON csco.SECTION_ID = dc.SECTION_ID
    AND csco.TERM_CODE = dc.SO_TERM_CODE
  WHERE lc.INSTRUCTOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
  (
    MAX(CASE WHEN (
        (IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM   IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM)   <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM_1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM_1) <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM_2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM_2) <> '')
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    +
    MAX(CASE WHEN (
        (IS_OFFERED_IAP   IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_IAP)   <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_IAP_1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_IAP_1) <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_IAP_2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_IAP_2) <> '')
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    +
    MAX(CASE WHEN (
        (IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM   IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM)   <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM_1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM_1) <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM_2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM_2) <> '')
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    +
    MAX(CASE WHEN (
        (IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM   IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM)   <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM_1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM_1) <> '')
     OR (IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM_2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM_2) <> '')
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS total_course_types
FROM instructor_offering_flags_by_course
WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY total_course_types DESC, instructor_name ASC

rows.question: What are the building names, department names, organizations, their highest and lowest floor number, along with the total number of rooms per each building key?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
room_rows_with_numeric_floor AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.ROOM AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR
  FROM fac_rooms AS fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.BUILDING_KEY <> ''
    AND fr.FLOOR IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.FLOOR <> ''
    -- require at least one leading numeric sequence; this excludes purely non-numeric floors
    AND fr.FLOOR REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?[0-9]+'
),
building_rows_with_keys AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM fac_building fb
  WHERE fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY <> ''
),
floor_aggregates AS (
  -- compute numeric highest and lowest floors and total distinct numeric-room count per building
  SELECT
    rr.BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(CAST(TRIM(rr.FLOOR) AS SIGNED)) AS HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
    MIN(CAST(TRIM(rr.FLOOR) AS SIGNED)) AS LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rr.ROOM_NUMBER) AS total_rooms_numeric_floors
  FROM room_rows_with_numeric_floor rr
  GROUP BY rr.BUILDING_KEY
),
room_counts_overall AS (
  -- total number of room rows per building from fac_rooms (counts all rooms regardless of floor parse)
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ROOM_COUNT
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.BUILDING_KEY <> ''
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
departments_per_building AS (
  -- department names via sis_department joined on DEPT_CODE from fac_rooms
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), '') SEPARATOR ', ') AS DEPARTMENT_OR_ORGANIZATION_NAMES
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fr.DEPT_CODE
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fr.BUILDING_KEY <> ''
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
organizations_per_building AS (
  -- organization names coming from fac_rooms.ORGANIZATION_NAME (and fclt_organization via fclt_organization.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY if available on fac_rooms.ORGANIZATION_KEY)
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME), '') SEPARATOR ', ') AS ORG_NAMES_FROM_FAC_ROOMS,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME), '') SEPARATOR ', ') AS ORG_NAMES_FROM_FCLT_ORG
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fr.BUILDING_KEY <> ''
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
combined_org_dept_names AS (
  -- combine department names and organization names into a single concatenated field per building
  SELECT
    bld.BUILDING_KEY,
    TRIM(
      BOTH ', ' FROM
      CONCAT_WS(
        ', ',
        NULLIF(dpb.DEPARTMENT_OR_ORGANIZATION_NAMES, ''),
        NULLIF(org.ORG_NAMES_FROM_FAC_ROOMS, ''),
        NULLIF(org.ORG_NAMES_FROM_FCLT_ORG, '')
      )
    ) AS DEPARTMENT_OR_ORGANIZATION_NAMES
  FROM building_rows_with_keys bld
  LEFT JOIN departments_per_building dpb ON dpb.BUILDING_KEY = bld.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN organizations_per_building org ON org.BUILDING_KEY = bld.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  -- prefer combined names; if none, return NULL
  NULLIF(c.DEPARTMENT_OR_ORGANIZATION_NAMES, '') AS DEPARTMENT_OR_ORGANIZATION_NAMES,
  -- floor aggregates: if no numeric floors found, return NULL for min/max per requirement
  fa.HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
  fa.LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
  -- total room count (from all fac_rooms rows). Use 0 if no rooms (but we filter buildings to those with rooms below).
  COALESCE(rc.TOTAL_ROOM_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOM_COUNT
FROM building_rows_with_keys b
JOIN room_counts_overall rc ON rc.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN floor_aggregates fa ON fa.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN combined_org_dept_names c ON c.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: Provide the complete information for students with the first name Kevin, including their full names, email addresses, department names, department phone numbers, school names, and the total student count per department and school. If a student is associated with more than one department, list a separate row for each department.

school_totals AS (
  SELECT
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
    -- count distinct students (by FULL_NAME) across all departments in the school
    SUM(sc.DEPARTMENT_COUNT) AS SCHOOL_COUNT
  FROM student_counts_by_department_and_school sc
  GROUP BY sc.SCHOOL_CODE
),
departments_and_schools_reference AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE IS NULL AND sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE IS NULL THEN sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
      WHEN sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE
      ELSE CONCAT('(', sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ') ', sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER)
    END AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE
  FROM student_department sd
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department sad
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
students_basic_directory AS (
  SELECT
    FULL_NAME,
    FIRST_NAME,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM mit_student_directory
)
SELECT
  s.FULL_NAME AS FULL_NAME,
  s.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COALESCE(sc.DEPARTMENT_COUNT, 0) AS DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT,
  COALESCE(st.SCHOOL_COUNT, 0) AS SCHOOL_STUDENT_COUNT
FROM students_basic_directory s
LEFT JOIN departments_and_schools_reference d
  ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE
LEFT JOIN student_counts_by_department_and_school sc
  ON d.DEPT_CODE = sc.DEPT_CODE
     AND d.SCHOOL_CODE = sc.SCHOOL_CODE
LEFT JOIN school_totals st
  ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = st.SCHOOL_CODE
WHERE s.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
ORDER BY s.FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH fall_offered_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, so.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    -- instructor name and mit id from subject_offered (preferred)
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    ccso.TERM_CODE AS CC_TERM_CODE
  FROM subject_offered AS so
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccso
    ON ccso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE
    -- require the offering row to indicate fall offering and term to be a fall term
    (ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR so.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA')
    AND so.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
),
instructor_emails AS (
  -- try to get email by MIT_ID; if MIT_ID not available, no email (NULL)
  SELECT
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  WHERE d.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  f.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ''), 'Unknown') AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  ie.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS INSTRUCTOR_EMAIL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_TYPE_COUNT_PER_INSTRUCTOR
FROM fall_offered_subjects f
LEFT JOIN instructor_emails ie
  ON f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
     AND ie.MIT_ID = f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
GROUP BY
  f.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ''), 'Unknown'),
  ie.EMAIL_ADDRESS
ORDER BY
  f.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ''), 'Unknown') ASC

rows.question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_core_74 AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
  `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
  `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  `BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  NULL AS DATE_BUILT
FROM `buildings`
WHERE `BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(NULL, '') <> '' -- placeholder to keep literal lifting rule; real DATE_BUILT comes from buildings which has no DATE_BUILT column
  AND 1=1
),
building_assignable_agg AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  SUM(fd.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS SUM_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  AVG(fd.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  COUNT(fd.FLOOR) AS SOURCE_ROW_COUNT
FROM buildings AS b
LEFT JOIN fac_floor AS fd
  ON fd.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
)
SELECT
  bc.BUILDING_NAME            AS building_name,
  bc.BUILDING_KEY             AS building_key,
  COALESCE(emp.hr_department_name, '') AS hr_department_name,
  bc.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS total_gross_sqft,
  COALESCE(ba.SUM_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS total_assignable_sqft_total,
  COALESCE(ba.AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS total_assignable_sqft_avg,
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bc.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS built_year
FROM buildings_core_74 bc
LEFT JOIN building_assignable_agg ba
  ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS BUILDING_KEY,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE SEPARATOR ', ') AS hr_department_name
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
  WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
) emp
  ON emp.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE bc.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND bc.DATE_BUILT IS NOT NULL
  AND bc.DATE_BUILT <> ''
ORDER BY bc.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: Retrieve the titles of subjects offered in the summer term along with their descriptions, responsible faculty names, email address, building name, room name, floor level, building street address, and the total number of types of courses per departmnet.

WITH subject_responsible_faculty AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    ded.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM subject_offered AS so
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor AS lci
    ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory AS ded
    ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ded.MIT_ID
),
dept_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GRADE_TYPE) AS total_course_types_per_department
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')
)
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION AS subject_description,
  srf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name,
  srf.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fcl.ROOM, c.MEET_PLACE) AS room_name,
  COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, fcl.FLOOR, NULL) AS floor_level,
  -- prefer fac_building_address STREET (ADDRESS_PURPOSE='STREET') if available, else use BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS on buildings
  COALESCE(aba.STREET_NUMBER,
           aba.STREET_NAME,
           b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS building_street_address,
  c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
  COALESCE(dtc.total_course_types_per_department, 0) AS total_course_types_per_department
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
LEFT JOIN subject_responsible_faculty srf
  -- Attempt to associate by section id where available; subject_offered used SECTION_ID as join key in CTE logic
  ON srf.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = c.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
  ON c.MEET_PLACE = fr.BUILDING_ROOM
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fcl
  ON c.MEET_PLACE = fcl.ROOM OR c.MEET_PLACE = fcl.SPACE_ID
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON (fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
     OR (fcl.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_KEY = fcl.BUILDING_KEY)
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address aba
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = aba.BUILDING_KEY
  AND aba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN dept_type_counts dtc
  ON COALESCE(c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') = dtc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE
  (
    (c.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(c.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU')
    OR c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU'
    OR c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y'
  )
ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ASC, c.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC

rows.question: For each term code, list the term description, attribute desciption, department name, school name, and the number of subjects in the area of humanities, arts and social sciences.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offering_term AS (
  SELECT
    ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    ccc.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM cis_course_catalog ccc
  WHERE ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE <> ''
    AND ccc.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND ccc.SUBJECT_ID <> ''
),
academic_terms_base AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM academic_terms at
),
subject_cis_attribute AS (
  SELECT
    ccc.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    cha.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP,
    COALESCE(cha.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN, cha.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM) AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    cha.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_TITLE
  FROM cis_course_catalog ccc
  JOIN cis_hass_attribute cha
    ON ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = cha.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
  WHERE ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
    AND ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
),
department_for_subject AS (
  SELECT
    ccc.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    -- try to get a nicer dept name from fac_organization if present
    COALESCE(f.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM cis_course_catalog ccc
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization f
    ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    OR f.D_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  atb.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  atb.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  sca.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  dfs.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- Map CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP 'H' to the human-readable school name if not otherwise provided
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(sca.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_TITLE, ''),
    CASE WHEN sca.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H' THEN 'Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences' END,
    'Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences'
  ) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sot.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_COUNT
FROM academic_terms_base atb
JOIN subject_offering_term sot
  ON sot.TERM_CODE = atb.TERM_CODE
JOIN subject_cis_attribute sca
  ON sca.SUBJECT_ID = sot.SUBJECT_ID
    AND sca.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
LEFT JOIN department_for_subject dfs
  ON dfs.SUBJECT_ID = sot.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE sot.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND sot.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  atb.TERM_CODE,
  atb.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  sca.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  dfs.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY atb.TERM_CODE ASC

rows.question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.

WITH building_core AS (
  SELECT
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `BUILDING_HEIGHT` AS `height`,
    `EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
    `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS `BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`
  FROM `fac_building`
),
building_room_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(fr.FLOOR, '') AS SIGNED)) AS min_floor_level,
    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(fr.FLOOR, '') AS SIGNED)) AS max_floor_level,
    SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area
  FROM `fac_rooms` AS fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
building_street_address_81 AS (
  SELECT
    fba.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    fba.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` AS `ADDRESS_PURPOSE`,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_NUMBER`, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.`STREET_NUMBER` IS NULL OR fba.`STREET_NUMBER` = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL`, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` IS NULL OR fba.`PRE_DIRECTIONAL` = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_NAME`, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.`STREET_SUFFIX` IS NULL OR fba.`STREET_SUFFIX` = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_SUFFIX`, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX` IS NULL OR fba.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX` = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX`, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.`POST_DIRECTIONAL` IS NULL OR fba.`POST_DIRECTIONAL` = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' END,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.`POST_DIRECTIONAL`, ''), '')
    )) AS `street_address`,
    fba.`CITY` AS `city`,
    fba.`STATE` AS `state`,
    fba.`POSTAL_CODE` AS `postal_code`
  FROM `fac_building_address` fba
  WHERE fba.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` IN ('STREET', 'MAIL', 'MAILING', 'STREET/MAIL')
),
-- ensure one street address per building (prefer ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET')
primary_street AS (
  SELECT
    bldg.BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(bldg.street_address) AS street_address,
    MIN(bldg.city) AS city,
    MIN(bldg.state) AS state,
    MIN(bldg.postal_code) AS postal_code
  FROM building_street_address_81 bldg
  WHERE bldg.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  GROUP BY bldg.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  bc.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  bc.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  bc.height AS height,
  ps.street_address AS street_address,
  ps.city AS city,
  ps.state AS state,
  ps.postal_code AS postal_code,
  bc.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  bc.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  bra.min_floor_level AS min_floor_level,
  bra.max_floor_level AS max_floor_level,
  bra.total_room_area AS total_room_area
FROM building_core bc
LEFT JOIN primary_street ps
  ON bc.BUILDING_KEY = ps.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_room_aggregates bra
  ON bc.BUILDING_KEY = bra.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: What is the category title, version, department name, school name, total number of courses for each course level, and the total number of degree-granting courses for each CIP category code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cip_category_master AS (
  SELECT
    `PROGRAM_CODE` AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE,
    `CATEGORY_CODE`,
    `CATEGORY_TITLE`,
    `VERSION`
  FROM `cip`
  WHERE `CATEGORY_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND `CATEGORY_CODE` <> ''
    AND `VERSION` IS NOT NULL AND `VERSION` <> ''
),
course_levels AS (
  -- unify course sources that reference a CIP four-digit code via HGN_CODE or CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
  SELECT
    cis.HGN_CODE AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE,
    sis.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    (CASE WHEN sis.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    COALESCE(sis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, drupal.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(sis.SCHOOL_NAME, drupal.SCHOOL_NAME, ccs.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    COALESCE(sis.COURSE, cis.SUBJECT_ID, drupal.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS COURSE_ID
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` cis
  LEFT JOIN `sis_course_description` sis
    ON sis.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cis.HGN_CODE
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` drupal
    ON drupal.HGN_CODE = cis.HGN_CODE
  LEFT JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered` ccs
    ON ccs.HGN_CODE = cis.HGN_CODE
  WHERE cis.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND cis.HGN_CODE <> ''
  UNION ALL
  -- include courses that appear only in sis_course_description keyed by CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
  SELECT
    sis.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE,
    sis.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    (CASE WHEN sis.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    sis.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sis.SCHOOL_NAME,
    sis.COURSE
  FROM `sis_course_description` sis
  WHERE sis.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sis.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE <> ''
  UNION ALL
  -- include direct mappings from course_catalog_subject_offered
  SELECT
    ccs.HGN_CODE AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE,
    NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    0 AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccs.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ccs.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` ccs
  WHERE ccs.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND ccs.HGN_CODE <> ''
  UNION ALL
  -- include drupal course catalog rows
  -- drupal_course_catalog has SCHOOL_NAME column named `SCHOOL_NAME` in the DDL; ensure referenced columns exist
  SELECT
    drupal.HGN_CODE AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE,
    drupal.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    0 AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    drupal.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    drupal.SCHOOL_NAME,
    drupal.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog` drupal
  WHERE drupal.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND drupal.HGN_CODE <> ''
),
category_course_counts AS (
  -- join CIP categories to the unified course_rows and aggregate counts by category and course level
  SELECT
    m.CATEGORY_CODE,
    m.CATEGORY_TITLE,
    m.VERSION,
    CASE WHEN cl.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'U'
         WHEN cl.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'G'
         ELSE NULL END AS COURSE_LEVEL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.COURSE_LEVEL IN ('U','G') THEN cl.COURSE_ID ELSE NULL END) AS COURSE_COUNT,
    SUM(cl.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS DEGREE_GRANTING_COUNT
  FROM cip_category_master m
  LEFT JOIN course_levels cl
    ON cl.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE = m.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE
  GROUP BY
    m.CATEGORY_CODE,
    m.CATEGORY_TITLE,
    m.VERSION,
    CASE WHEN cl.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'U'
         WHEN cl.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'G'
         ELSE NULL END
)
SELECT
  CATEGORY_TITLE           AS category_title,
  CATEGORY_CODE            AS category_cip_code,
  VERSION                  AS category_version,
  COURSE_LEVEL             AS course_level,
  COALESCE(COURSE_COUNT, 0)  AS total_courses_for_level,
  COALESCE(DEGREE_GRANTING_COUNT, 0) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM category_course_counts
WHERE CATEGORY_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_CODE <> ''
  AND COURSE_LEVEL IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE, COURSE_LEVEL

rows.question: What is the total number of library materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of materials status for each course name?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH material_years AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS material_id,
    -- normalize numeric years only, trim whitespace; else NULL
    CASE
      WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,4}[[:space:]]*$'
        THEN CAST(TRIM(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR) AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pub_year
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
),
course_materials_joined AS (
  SELECT
    -- use the course title from library_subject_offered when available, else from subject_offered
    COALESCE(lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS course_name,
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS material_id,
    my.pub_year,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS status
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
  JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN material_years my
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = my.material_id
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
    -- keep a simple, joinable relationship: match subject identifiers where possible
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = lmd.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE
    -- include only rows where a material is associated to a course via library_subject_offered OR subject id
    (lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL OR lmd.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
    -- ensure we have a material id (should be always true because of join), defensive:
    AND lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  cm.course_name AS course_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials,
  MIN(cm.pub_year) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(cm.pub_year) AS max_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.status) AS total_materials_status_count
FROM course_materials_joined cm
-- exclude rows lacking a course name so we don't aggregate materials with no course label
WHERE cm.course_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cm.course_name
ORDER BY cm.course_name ASC
