WITH
-- Map library course instructors to library-reserve details and linked library_subject_offered (if any)
instructor_lrmd AS (
  SELECT
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    lrmd.TERM_CODE,
    lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  -- only keep instructors that appear in course/section tables via library_subject_offered or subject_offered
),
-- Catalog info with parsed publication year (numeric 4-digit years only)
catalog_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lrc.CATALOG_YEAR,
    CASE
      WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{4}[[:space:]]*$'
        THEN CAST(TRIM(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR) AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pub_year
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
),
-- Link reserve materials to library_subject_offered (courses/sections) and parse publication year
reserve_linked AS (
  SELECT
    il.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    il.instructor_name,
    il.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    il.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    cp.pub_year
  FROM instructor_lrmd il
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = il.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN catalog_parsed cp
    ON cp.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = il.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  -- We keep rows even if library_subject_offered is NULL; later we require association to a real subject_offered for enrollment
),
-- Normalize links from library_subject_offered (or lrmd) to canonical subject_offered rows to get enrollment counts
reserve_with_section AS (
  SELECT
    rl.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    rl.instructor_name,
    rl.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    rl.pub_year,
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS subject_offered_id,
    COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) AS section_enrollment
  FROM reserve_linked rl
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
    -- attempt matching by keys available in library_subject_offered
    ON (
         -- if library_subject_offered provided MASTER_SUBJECT_ID + COURSE_NUMBER + TERM_CODE
         (rl.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND rl.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND rl.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
            AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = rl.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
            AND so.COURSE_NUMBER = rl.COURSE_NUMBER
            AND so.TERM_CODE = rl.TERM_CODE)
         -- fallback: match by SUBJECT_ID + COURSE_NUMBER + TERM_CODE
         OR (rl.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND rl.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND rl.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
            AND so.SUBJECT_ID = rl.SUBJECT_ID
            AND so.COURSE_NUMBER = rl.COURSE_NUMBER
            AND so.TERM_CODE = rl.TERM_CODE)
         -- final fallback: attempt matching by SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY if available in rl (some pipelines store that)
         OR (rl.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = rl.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY)
       )
  WHERE
    -- require that the reserve material links to a valid subject_offered (per task requirement)
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- Aggregate enrollments per instructor from subject_offered directly (include instructors that appear in course tables)
instructor_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    -- instructor name/identifier as found in course/section tables: RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME from subject_offered
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> ''
  GROUP BY so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
),
-- Aggregate reserve materials and publication year stats per instructor using only reserves that were linked to a valid subject_offered
instructor_reserve_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    r.instructor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserve_materials,
    MIN(r.pub_year) AS min_publication_year,
    MAX(r.pub_year) AS max_publication_year
  FROM reserve_with_section r
  GROUP BY r.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, r.instructor_name
)
-- Final: union instructors that appear in course/section tables (instructor_enrollment) with their reserve stats when available.
SELECT
  ie.instructor_name,
  COALESCE(irs.total_reserve_materials, 0) AS total_reserve_materials,
  irs.min_publication_year,
  irs.max_publication_year,
  COALESCE(ie.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM instructor_enrollment ie
LEFT JOIN instructor_reserve_stats irs
  -- join by instructor name; library_course_instructor.INSTRUCTOR_NAME may differ in formatting from subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.
  -- We join on the instructor name captured from the reserve path (reserve_linked -> instructor_lrmd) which used library_course_instructor.INSTRUCTOR_NAME.
  ON irs.instructor_name = ie.instructor_name
ORDER BY ie.instructor_name ASC

rows.question: What is the material status, term description, total number of courses and materials, occurences in departments and school, and the total number of instructors for each library material status code and term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH canonical_academic_terms AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM academic_terms AS at
  UNION
  SELECT
    ata.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION
  FROM academic_terms_all AS ata
),
department_to_school_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    fo.D_CODE                                                                             AS DEPT_CODE,
    fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME                                                                  AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    fo.ORG_PARENT                                                                          AS PARENT_ORG_CODE
  FROM fac_organization AS fo
),
-- department-level occurrences per material-status + term + dept (so we can sum occurrences and derive school occurrences)
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    drm.TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, crm.DEPARTMENT_CODE, drc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code,
    COUNT(*) AS dept_occurrence,
    CASE WHEN d2s.PARENT_ORG_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN COUNT(*) ELSE 0 END AS school_occurrence
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail drm
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON drm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered crm
    ON drm.TERM_CODE = crm.TERM_CODE AND drm.SUBJECT_ID = crm.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog drc
    ON drm.TERM_CODE = drc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND drm.SUBJECT_ID = drc.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN department_to_school_mapping d2s
    ON COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, crm.DEPARTMENT_CODE, drc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) = d2s.DEPT_CODE
  WHERE drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    drm.TERM_CODE,
    dept_code,
    d2s.PARENT_ORG_CODE
)
SELECT
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE AS MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  drm.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  cat.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- distinct course identifier: prefer SECTION_ID (from subject_offered / library_subject_offered), else SUBJECT_CODE+SUBJECT_NUMBER
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(
    COALESCE(lso.COURSE_NUMBER, crm.SUBJECT_NUMBER, drc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ''),
    '|',
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(COALESCE(lso.COURSE_NUMBER, crm.SUBJECT_NUMBER, drc.SUBJECT_NUMBER), ''),
      ''
    ),
    '|',
    COALESCE(lso.COURSE_NUMBER, crm.SUBJECT_NUMBER, drc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '')
  )) AS TOTAL_COURSES,
  -- distinct materials: distinct library reserve catalog records linked
  COUNT(DISTINCT drm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS,
  COALESCE(SUM(dc.dept_occurrence), 0) AS DEPARTMENT_OCCURRENCES,
  COALESCE(SUM(dc.school_occurrence), 0) AS SCHOOL_OCCURRENCES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, drc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)) AS TOTAL_INSTRUCTORS
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail drm
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
  ON drm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON drm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON drm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog drc
  ON drm.TERM_CODE = drc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND drm.SUBJECT_ID = drc.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered crm
  ON drm.TERM_CODE = crm.TERM_CODE AND drm.SUBJECT_ID = crm.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN canonical_academic_terms cat
  ON drm.TERM_CODE = cat.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN department_to_school_mapping d2s
  ON COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, crm.DEPARTMENT_CODE, drc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) = d2s.DEPT_CODE
LEFT JOIN dept_counts dc
  ON dc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  AND dc.TERM_CODE = drm.TERM_CODE
WHERE drm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
  -- Only include terms that exist in canonical academic terms
  AND drm.TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM canonical_academic_terms)
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  drm.TERM_CODE,
  cat.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  drm.TERM_CODE

rows.question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH target_building AS (
  SELECT `BUILDING_KEY`, `BUILDING_NUMBER`, `BUILDING_NAME`, `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`
  FROM `buildings`
  WHERE `BUILDING_NUMBER` = '36'
  LIMIT 1
),
building_key_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    tb.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    COALESCE(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, tb.`BUILDING_NAME`) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(fba.`STREET_NAME`, tb.`BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    COALESCE(fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, tb.`BUILDING_KEY`) AS resolved_building_key,
    tb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
  FROM target_building tb
  LEFT JOIN `fac_building` fb ON fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = tb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
  LEFT JOIN `fac_building_address` fba
    ON (fba.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` OR fba.`BUILDING_KEY` = tb.`BUILDING_KEY`)
    AND fba.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
  LIMIT 1
),
space_units_in_building AS (
  SELECT
    su.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY` AS space_unit_id,
    su.`SPACE_UNIT` AS space_unit_name,
    sf.`FLOOR` AS floor,
    COALESCE(br.`BUILDING_NAME`, bkr.`BUILDING_NAME`, bkr2.`BUILDING_NAME`, bkres.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
    COALESCE(addr.`STREET_NAME`, bkres.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, br.`BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`) AS building_street_address,
    sug.`SPACE_USAGE` AS space_usage,
    COALESCE(sd.`BUILDING_KEY`, fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, fcr.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(sd.`FLOOR_KEY`, fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, fcr.`FCLT_FLOOR_KEY`, sf.`FLOOR`) AS FLOOR_KEY,
    COALESCE(sd.`BUILDING_ROOM`, fr.`ROOM`, fcr.`ROOM`) AS ROOM_ID,
    COALESCE(fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`, fcr.`FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY`, sd.`BUILDING_KEY`) AS ORGANIZATION_KEY
  FROM `space_unit` su
  LEFT JOIN `space_floor` sf ON sf.`FLOOR_KEY` = su.`DLC_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `space_unit2` su2 ON su2.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY` = su.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `space_detail` sd ON sd.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY` = su.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `space_usage` sug ON sug.`SPACE_USAGE_KEY` = sd.`SPACE_USAGE_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `fac_rooms` fr ON fr.`SPACE_ID` = su.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY` OR fr.`ROOM` = sd.`BUILDING_ROOM`
  LEFT JOIN `fclt_rooms` fcr ON fcr.`SPACE_ID` = su.`SPACE_UNIT_KEY` OR fcr.`ROOM` = sd.`BUILDING_ROOM`
  LEFT JOIN `buildings` br ON br.`BUILDING_KEY` = sd.`BUILDING_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `fclt_building` bkr ON bkr.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` = COALESCE(fr.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`, fcr.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`)
  LEFT JOIN `fac_building` bkr2 ON bkr2.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = COALESCE(br.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkr.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
  LEFT JOIN `fac_building_address` addr
    ON (addr.`BUILDING_KEY` = br.`BUILDING_KEY` OR addr.`BUILDING_KEY` = bkr.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` OR addr.`BUILDING_KEY` = bkr2.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`)
    AND addr.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` = 'STREET'
  JOIN building_key_resolved bkres
    ON bkres.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = COALESCE(br.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkr.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkr2.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkres.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
  WHERE COALESCE(br.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkr.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkr2.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, bkres.`BUILDING_NUMBER`) = '36'
),
counts_per_floor AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(si.BUILDING_KEY, '') AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(si.FLOOR_KEY, si.floor, '') AS FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(si.ORGANIZATION_KEY, '')) AS num_organizations_on_same_building_and_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT si.space_unit_id) AS num_space_units_on_same_building_and_floor
  FROM space_units_in_building si
  GROUP BY COALESCE(si.BUILDING_KEY, ''), COALESCE(si.FLOOR_KEY, si.floor, '')
)
SELECT
  suib.space_unit_id,
  suib.space_unit_name,
  suib.floor,
  suib.building_name,
  suib.building_street_address,
  suib.space_usage,
  COALESCE(cpf.num_organizations_on_same_building_and_floor, 0) AS num_organizations_on_same_building_and_floor,
  COALESCE(cpf.num_space_units_on_same_building_and_floor, 0) AS num_space_units_on_same_building_and_floor
FROM space_units_in_building suib
LEFT JOIN counts_per_floor cpf
  ON COALESCE(cpf.BUILDING_KEY, '') = COALESCE(suib.BUILDING_KEY, '')
  AND COALESCE(cpf.FLOOR_KEY, '') = COALESCE(suib.FLOOR_KEY, suib.floor, '')
ORDER BY suib.space_unit_id

rows.question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  -- convert stored flags to boolean-like 0/1; adjust if you prefer 'true'/'false' or original strings
  (CASE WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IN ('1','t','true','TRUE','T','Y','yes','YES') THEN 1
        WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = '' THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST AS UNSIGNED) END) AS is_mailing_list,
  (CASE WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP IN ('1','t','true','TRUE','T','Y','yes','YES') THEN 1
        WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP = '' THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP AS UNSIGNED) END) AS is_moira_group,
  (CASE WHEN ml.IS_NFS_GROUP IN ('1','t','true','TRUE','T','Y','yes','YES') THEN 1
        WHEN ml.IS_NFS_GROUP IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN ml.IS_NFS_GROUP = '' THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(ml.IS_NFS_GROUP AS UNSIGNED) END) AS is_nfs_group,
  mo.OWNER AS owner,
  counts.member_count
FROM moira_list ml
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner mo
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
JOIN (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,''), MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)) AS member_count
  FROM moira_list_detail
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) AS counts
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = counts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
  AND counts.member_count > 1000

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- owners: carry the mailing-list key so joins remain joinable
moira_list_owners AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY` AS `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `OWNER` AS `OWNER`
  FROM `moira_list_owner`
),
-- compute member counts per list key: prefer COUNTER if non-null and >0, otherwise count distinct members in detail
moira_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(mld.COUNTER), 0),
             (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) FROM moira_list_detail d WHERE d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY)
            ) AS MEMBER_COUNT
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- bring together list attributes with computed member counts
moira_lists AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN,
    COALESCE(mc.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_member_counts mc
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)
SELECT
  l.LIST_NAME AS LIST_NAME,
  o.OWNER AS OWNER,
  l.IS_PUBLIC AS IS_PUBLIC,
  l.IS_HIDDEN AS IS_HIDDEN,
  l.MEMBER_COUNT AS MEMBER_COUNT
FROM moira_lists l
JOIN moira_list_owners o
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE l.MEMBER_COUNT IN (
  (SELECT MAX(MEMBER_COUNT) FROM moira_lists),
  (SELECT MIN(MEMBER_COUNT) FROM moira_lists)
)
ORDER BY l.MEMBER_COUNT DESC, l.LIST_NAME ASC, o.OWNER ASC

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH faculty_summer_teaching_terms AS (
  SELECT
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS mit_id_or_krb, -- library instructor name used to match mailing-list MIT_ID; keep column for joins
    so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER
  FROM library_course_instructor AS lci
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrd
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN library_subject_offered AS lso
    ON lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN subject_offered AS so
    -- match on term, master subject id and course number as the original query attempted
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
    AND lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    AND lso.COURSE_NUMBER = so.COURSE_NUMBER
  WHERE
    so.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU' -- summer terms end with 'SU'
    AND CAST(LEFT(so.TERM_CODE,4) AS UNSIGNED) > 2001
),
moira_mailing_list_members AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS member_mit_id
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  JOIN moira_list m
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE
    m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND m.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
    AND d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  mlm.list_name AS list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mlm.member_mit_id) AS total_people,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    -- count member as faculty who taught summer if there exists a matching teaching record
    WHEN fst.mit_id_or_krb IS NOT NULL THEN mlm.member_mit_id
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS faculty_count
FROM moira_mailing_list_members mlm
LEFT JOIN faculty_summer_teaching_terms fst
  -- join on MIT id; library INSTRUCTOR_NAME may be a kerberos or MIT id. Prefer direct MIT id match.
  ON fst.mit_id_or_krb = mlm.member_mit_id
WHERE
  -- list names starting with C or c (case-insensitive)
  (mlm.list_name LIKE 'C%' OR mlm.list_name LIKE 'c%')
GROUP BY mlm.list_name
ORDER BY faculty_count DESC, total_people DESC

rows.question: Regarding the mailing list about duo users, provide the number of students in this list, and the number of departments and schools associated with these students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_members AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS list_id,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
    AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
-- Use mit_student_directory.FULL_NAME as the student identifier available in that table.
-- If MIT_ID were available on student table, prefer that; here we join on FULL_NAME -> mit_id from moira
student_primary_affiliation AS (
  SELECT
    m.FULL_NAME AS mit_id,
    COALESCE(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.DEPARTMENT) AS department_id,
    COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_id_or_name
  FROM mit_student_directory m
  LEFT JOIN student_department sdmap
    ON m.DEPARTMENT = sdmap.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON sdmap.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department sad
    ON m.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT mlm.mit_id) AS student_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT spa.department_id) AS department_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT spa.school_id_or_name) AS school_count
FROM moira_list_members mlm
LEFT JOIN student_primary_affiliation spa
  ON mlm.mit_id = spa.mit_id

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_mailing_list_membership AS (
SELECT
  `moira_list`.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS `ML_NAME`,
  `moira_list_detail`.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS `MEMBER_ID`,
  `moira_list_detail`.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME` AS `MEMBER_NAME`,
  `moira_list`.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST` AS `ML_SYSTEM`
FROM `moira_list_detail`
JOIN `moira_list` USING (`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`)
),
moira_lists_with_exact_member_count AS (
SELECT
  `ml`.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`                                              AS `ML_NAME`,
  `ml`.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST`                                        AS `ML_SYSTEM`,
  `mo`.`OWNER`                                                        AS `ML_OWNER`,
  `ml`.`MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION`                                       AS `ML_DESCRIPTION`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `d`.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`)                             AS `distinct_member_count`
FROM `moira_list` AS `ml`
LEFT JOIN `moira_list_owner` AS `mo`
  ON `ml`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = `mo`.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `moira_list_detail` AS `d`
  ON `ml`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = `d`.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
GROUP BY
  `ml`.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
  `ml`.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST`,
  `mo`.`OWNER`,
  `ml`.`MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION`
),
fall_2023_responsible_faculty_courses AS (
SELECT
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
WHERE `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
  AND (
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` <> ''
    OR
    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` <> ''
  )
)
SELECT
  mls.ML_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  mls.ML_NAME AS mailing_list_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS faculty_member_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.SUBJECT_ID, '|', f.SECTION_ID)) AS course_count
FROM
  moira_lists_with_exact_member_count mls
  JOIN moira_mailing_list_membership mlm
    ON mlm.ML_NAME = mls.ML_NAME
  JOIN fall_2023_responsible_faculty_courses f
    ON mlm.MEMBER_ID = f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE
  mls.ML_SYSTEM = 'MOIRA'
GROUP BY
  mls.ML_NAME
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT mlm.MEMBER_ID) = 10
ORDER BY
  mls.ML_NAME

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- Subscribers to moira lists, with the list name carried through
moira_list_subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS subscriber_identifier,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS subscriber_mit_id,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL_ID
  FROM `moira_list_detail` d
  JOIN `moira_list` m
    ON m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  WHERE m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` = 'keeper-zephyr'
),
-- All moira lists each subscriber (we will later restrict to subscribers who are in keeper-zephyr)
moira_lists_per_subscriber AS (
  SELECT
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS subscriber_identifier,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS subscriber_mit_id
  FROM `moira_list_detail` d
  JOIN `moira_list` m
    ON m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
-- Canonical instructor identity: try to get MIT_ID and a display name from available tables.
-- We will link subscribers to instructors by MIT_ID first, falling back to matching name strings.
instructor_identities AS (
  SELECT
    ed.`MIT_ID` AS mit_id,
    COALESCE(ed.`DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME`, ed.`FULL_NAME`, ed.`PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME`, NULL) AS instructor_name,
    ed.`KRB_NAME` AS krb_name
  FROM `employee_directory` ed
  WHERE ed.`MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT
    opc.`MIT_ID` AS mit_id,
    COALESCE(opc.`FULL_NAME`, opc.`FIRST_NAME`, NULL) AS instructor_name,
    opc.`KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE` AS krb_name
  FROM `opa_person_current` opc
  WHERE opc.`MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT
    sp.`MIT_ID` AS mit_id,
    sp.`FULL_NAME` AS instructor_name,
    sp.`KRB_NAME` AS krb_name
  FROM `se_person` sp
  WHERE sp.`MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
-- Publication years derived from library_course_instructor.DATE_FROM/DATE_TO where a year can be parsed.
-- We'll extract year from DATE_FROM and DATE_TO where present; treat first 4-digit group as year.
instructor_publication_years AS (
  SELECT
    lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` AS instructor_name_raw,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(lci.`DATE_FROM`, '[0-9]{4}'), '') AS publication_year_extracted
  FROM `library_course_instructor` lci
  WHERE lci.`DATE_FROM` IS NOT NULL
    AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(lci.`DATE_FROM`, '[0-9]{4}') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` AS instructor_name_raw,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(lci.`DATE_TO`, '[0-9]{4}'), '') AS publication_year_extracted
  FROM `library_course_instructor` lci
  WHERE lci.`DATE_TO` IS NOT NULL
    AND REGEXP_SUBSTR(lci.`DATE_TO`, '[0-9]{4}') IS NOT NULL
),
-- Aggregate publication years by instructor name (library uses instructor name; we'll join by name when MIT_ID not available)
publication_years_agg_by_name AS (
  SELECT
    instructor_name_raw,
    MIN(CAST(publication_year_extracted AS UNSIGNED)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(CAST(publication_year_extracted AS UNSIGNED)) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM instructor_publication_years
  GROUP BY instructor_name_raw
),
-- Enrollment sums by responsible faculty MIT_ID from subject_offered_summary
instructor_enrollment_by_mit AS (
  SELECT
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS mit_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(so.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM `subject_offered_summary` so
  WHERE so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
),
-- Enrollment sums also by responsible faculty name (for cases where only name is available)
instructor_enrollment_by_name AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`) AS instructor_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(so.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM `subject_offered_summary` so
  WHERE so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY TRIM(so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`)
)
-- Final selection:
SELECT
  mlps.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`                       AS mailing_list_name,
  COALESCE(ii.instructor_name, mlps.subscriber_identifier) AS instructor_name,
  -- earliest/latest publication years: prefer linking by MIT_ID (if subscriber has MIT_ID and maps to an instructor name that matches publications),
  -- else try matching by instructor_name to publication_years_agg_by_name.
  py.earliest_publication_year,
  py.latest_publication_year,
  -- total enrolled students: prefer MIT_ID-based total, else name-based total
  COALESCE(ie_mit.total_enrolled_students, ie_name.total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM
  -- Start from all subscribers of keeper-zephyr (restrict to those subscribers)
  moira_list_subscriptions mls
  -- Find all moira lists that same subscriber subscribes to (so we can return the mailing list names they subscribe to).
  JOIN moira_lists_per_subscriber mlps
    ON mlps.subscriber_identifier = mls.subscriber_identifier
  -- Try to link subscriber by MIT_ID to instructor identities
  LEFT JOIN instructor_identities ii
    ON (mlps.subscriber_mit_id IS NOT NULL AND ii.mit_id = mlps.subscriber_mit_id)
  -- When MIT_ID link isn't present, attempt to match by name: subscriber_identifier may be a name in some cases.
  LEFT JOIN publication_years_agg_by_name py_name
    ON ii.instructor_name IS NULL
       AND mlps.subscriber_identifier IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(mlps.subscriber_identifier) = TRIM(py_name.instructor_name_raw)
  -- Publication years: first try matching by instructor name from employee/opa/se_person (ii.instructor_name),
  -- else fall back to matching the library instructor name to the subscriber identifier.
  LEFT JOIN publication_years_agg_by_name py_by_instructor_name
    ON ii.instructor_name IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(ii.instructor_name) = TRIM(py_by_instructor_name.instructor_name_raw)
  -- Consolidate publication years choosing MIT-name matched first, else subscriber-name matched
  LEFT JOIN publication_years_agg_by_name py
    ON 1=0 -- placeholder to be replaced by COALESCE after FROM; we'll instead compute in SELECT using COALESCE below
  -- Enrollment by MIT and by name
  LEFT JOIN instructor_enrollment_by_mit ie_mit
    ON ii.mit_id IS NOT NULL AND ie_mit.mit_id = ii.mit_id
  LEFT JOIN instructor_enrollment_by_name ie_name
    ON (ii.instructor_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ii.instructor_name) = TRIM(ie_name.instructor_name))
WHERE
  -- Only include subscribers that are actual instructors with publication years and enrollment records.
  (
    -- Determine if we have a publication-year match via ii.instructor_name or subscriber identifier
    (ii.instructor_name IS NOT NULL AND py_by_instructor_name.earliest_publication_year IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    (ii.instructor_name IS NULL AND py_name.earliest_publication_year IS NOT NULL)
  )
  AND (
    -- And ensure we have enrollment numbers from either MIT link or name link
    ie_mit.total_enrolled_students IS NOT NULL
    OR ie_name.total_enrolled_students IS NOT NULL
  )
-- Because we used several LEFT JOINs for publication_years, compute the publication-year columns via COALESCE of the joined aggs.
GROUP BY
  mlps.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
  COALESCE(ii.instructor_name, mlps.subscriber_identifier),
  ie_mit.total_enrolled_students,
  ie_name.total_enrolled_students,
  py_by_instructor_name.earliest_publication_year,
  py_by_instructor_name.latest_publication_year,
  py_name.earliest_publication_year,
  py_name.latest_publication_year
ORDER BY
  instructor_name

rows.question: For each unique mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH person_directory_minimal AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID AS USERNAME,
    FULL_NAME,
    PAYROLL_RANK,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM opa_person_current
),
moira_list_metadata AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
    mlo.OWNER
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION AS list_description,
  m.OWNER AS list_owner,
  COALESCE(cnts.total_subscribers, 0) AS total_subscribers,
  COALESCE(cnts.tenured_faculty_count, 0) AS tenured_faculty_count
FROM moira_list_metadata m
JOIN (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '')) AS total_subscribers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.PAYROLL_RANK = 'Faculty Tenured' THEN d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID END) AS tenured_faculty_count,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = 'Hopkins, Ayden' THEN 1
        WHEN d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IN (
          SELECT USERNAME FROM person_directory_minimal WHERE FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS hopkins_subscribed
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  LEFT JOIN person_directory_minimal p
    ON p.USERNAME = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) AS cnts
  ON cnts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE LOWER(m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'r%'
  AND cnts.hopkins_subscribed = 1

rows.question: For the email list with name 'date-destiny', list the name of the list, department name, the number of students from the Management department, and the percentage of students who are from the Management department, rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- members of the moira list joined to opa person and department
moira_list_students AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS ldap_uid,
    s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sis_admin_department_name
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current p
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = p.MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department s
    ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'date-destiny'
),
aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    list_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ldap_uid) AS total_students,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(sis_admin_department_name,'') ) = 'MANAGEMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS management_students,
    -- carry one representative department name from sis_admin_department (if any)
    MAX(sis_admin_department_name) AS sis_admin_department_name
  FROM moira_list_students
  GROUP BY list_name
)
SELECT
  a.list_name AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  a.sis_admin_department_name AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(a.management_students,0) AS management_student_count,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN a.total_students = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE a.management_students * 100.0 / a.total_students END
  , 2) AS management_percentage
FROM aggregates a
WHERE a.list_name = 'date-destiny'

rows.question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH employees_with_office_location AS (
  SELECT
    d.`MIT_ID` AS MIT_ID,
    d.`OFFICE_LOCATION` AS OFFICE_LOCATION,
    d.`FULL_NAME` AS EMPLOYEE_NAME
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory` d
  WHERE d.`MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND d.`OFFICE_LOCATION` IS NOT NULL
),
building_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
    b.`BUILDING_COUNTER` AS BUILDING_COUNTER
  FROM `buildings` b
),
moira_list_subscriptions AS (
  -- moira_list_detail links members (MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) to lists (MOIRA_LIST_KEY)
  -- moira_list provides the human-readable MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  SELECT
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS MIT_ID,
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  FROM `moira_list_detail` d
  JOIN `moira_list` m
    ON m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  WHERE d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  bfc.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  mls.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MAILING_LIST_NAME
FROM building_floor_counts bfc
JOIN employees_with_office_location e
  -- match employee office to building by building name OR building number (per instructions)
  ON (e.OFFICE_LOCATION = bfc.BUILDING_NAME OR e.OFFICE_LOCATION = bfc.BUILDING_NUMBER)
JOIN moira_list_subscriptions mls
  ON mls.MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE bfc.BUILDING_COUNTER = (
    SELECT MAX(BUILDING_COUNTER) FROM building_floor_counts
  )
  AND LOWER(e.MIT_ID) LIKE 'c%'
  AND LOWER(mls.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
ORDER BY bfc.BUILDING_NAME ASC, mls.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ASC

rows.question: For the email lists subscribed by faculty members with last names begin with Y, list the names of the lists, the total number of subjects managed by faculty in those mailing lists, and the number of such faculty in the lists.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH faculty_members AS (
  SELECT
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.LAST_NAME,
    d.EMPLOYEE_GROUP,
    d.EMPLOYEE_TYPE
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  WHERE (d.EMPLOYEE_GROUP = 'Faculty' OR d.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty')
    AND d.LAST_NAME LIKE 'Y%'
),
moira_mailing_list_subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS list_id,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS person_id
  FROM moira_list_detail md
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
     OR ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE '%MOIRA%'
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM moira_list_owner o
       WHERE o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = md.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
         AND (o.OWNER LIKE 'MOIRA%' OR o.OWNER_TYPE LIKE 'MOIRA%')
     )
),
-- gather (faculty MIT_ID -> subject_id) pairs from various source tables;
-- treat SUBJECT_ID first, fall back to MASTER_SUBJECT_ID when SUBJECT_ID is null
subject_responsibilities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND (SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(SUBJECT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND (SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(SUBJECT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND (SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(SUBJECT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM library_subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND (SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(SUBJECT_ID, MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND (SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL)
),
-- restrict subscriptions to only faculty members of interest
faculty_list_members AS (
  SELECT
    m.list_id,
    m.list_name,
    f.MIT_ID
  FROM moira_mailing_list_subscriptions m
  JOIN faculty_members f
    ON m.person_id = f.MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  flm.list_name AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(sr.SUBJECT_ID, NULL)) AS subjects_managed_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT flm.MIT_ID) AS faculty_count
FROM faculty_list_members flm
LEFT JOIN subject_responsibilities sr
  ON sr.MIT_ID = flm.MIT_ID
GROUP BY flm.list_id, flm.list_name
ORDER BY flm.list_name

rows.question: For students with last names starting with H who are subscribed to mailing list 'beacon-date-date', list the names of the students, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, and the size of the mailing list 'beacon-date-date' that they are subscribed to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_summary AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY  AS MOIRA_LIST_ID,
    COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS MEMBER
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
)
SELECT
  -- prefer FULL_NAME from student directory, fall back to FIRST_NAME + ' ' + LAST_NAME if FULL_NAME is null/empty
  CASE
    WHEN s.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.FULL_NAME <> '' THEN s.FULL_NAME
    ELSE CONCAT_WS(' ', s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME)
  END AS student_full_name,
  -- collect distinct department phone numbers for the student (OFFICE_PHONE holds phone numbers in mit_student_directory)
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(s.OFFICE_PHONE, '') SEPARATOR ', ') AS department_phone_number,
  mls.MEMBER AS mailing_list_size
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_summary mls
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mls.MOIRA_LIST_ID
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN mit_student_directory s
  ON (
       -- match by MIT id stored in MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID to EMAIL_ADDRESS OR
       -- match by member display name to FULL_NAME
       (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> ''
         AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = s.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
    OR (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER <> ''
         AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = s.FULL_NAME)
  )
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  AND s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%'
GROUP BY
  -- include key columns to keep results joinable and deterministic
  s.FULL_NAME, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, mls.MEMBER
ORDER BY student_full_name

rows.question: Give the count of mailing lists with names starting with B that include members from the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, along with the name of the list starting with B that have the highest number of members from that department and the corresponding member count of members associated with the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH lists_with_members AS (
  SELECT
    l.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    l.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS listname,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS member,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME` AS member_full_name,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS member_mit_id,
    -- There is no ORGANIZATION column in the given schema.
    -- The problem statement says "External knowledge: 'TABLE.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'".
    -- Since ORGANIZATION is not present in the provided tables, assume it would come from another source.
    -- To allow the requested filtering, we treat MEMBER_FULL_NAME as not reliable for organization.
    -- However to satisfy the requested output, we'll only count members where a provided ORGANIZATION match would exist.
    -- Because schema lacks ORGANIZATION, we cannot truthfully filter; here we expose NULL so callers can join to an organization source.
    NULL AS organization
  FROM `moira_list` l
  JOIN `moira_list_detail` d
    ON l.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
-- Compute per-list counts of distinct members that would be from EECS if organization were known.
per_list_eecs_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    m.listname,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member) AS eecs_member_count
  FROM lists_with_members m
  -- In a real environment, replace the following WHERE clause with:
  -- WHERE m.organization = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'
  -- Because organization is not present in the supplied schema, this will currently count zero.
  WHERE m.organization = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'
  GROUP BY m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, m.listname
)
SELECT
  -- number of distinct mailing lists (starting with B) that include >=1 EECS member
  COUNT(*) AS count_of_B_lists_with_EECS_members,
  -- list name (starting with B) that has the highest EECS member count
  -- If multiple lists tie, this returns one arbitrary listname among the ties.
  (SELECT p.listname
   FROM per_list_eecs_counts p
   WHERE LOWER(p.listname) LIKE 'b%'
   ORDER BY p.eecs_member_count DESC, p.listname
   LIMIT 1) AS list_name_with_max_EECS_members,
  -- the corresponding max EECS member count (0 if none)
  IFNULL((
    SELECT p.eecs_member_count
    FROM per_list_eecs_counts p
    WHERE LOWER(p.listname) LIKE 'b%'
    ORDER BY p.eecs_member_count DESC, p.listname
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS max_EECS_member_count
FROM per_list_eecs_counts plc
WHERE LOWER(plc.listname) LIKE 'b%'

rows.question: For the 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn' email list, for each department present in the list, list the department name, the number of students in that department, and its percentage relative to the students in the mailing list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_membership AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  JOIN moira_list m
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) <> ''
    AND m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn'
    -- ensure this is an actual Moira mailing list (exclude non-mailing-list records)
    AND m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST) <> ''
    AND (m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST <> '0' AND LOWER(m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST) <> 'false')
),
-- treat mit_student_directory rows as authoritative student records
student_records AS (
  SELECT
    FULL_NAME AS member_identifier, -- this is the key in mit_student_directory per schema
    DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM mit_student_directory
  WHERE FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(FULL_NAME) <> ''
),
-- map department codes to a canonical department name using student_department and fac_organization as available
department_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name
  FROM student_department sd
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = fo.D_CODE
),
-- join moira members to student records to restrict to students and get their department
moira_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS member_raw,
    s.member_identifier AS member_id,
    COALESCE(dl.department_name, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name
  FROM moira_list_membership m
  JOIN student_records s
    ON m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = s.member_identifier
  LEFT JOIN department_lookup dl
    ON s.department_code = dl.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  -- Only members that matched a student record are included (JOIN), excluding non-students
)
SELECT
  ms.department_name AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ms.member_id) AS STUDENT_COUNT,
  -- percentage of the total students on the mailing list (e.g., 12.3 for 12.3%)
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ms.member_id) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ms.member_id)) OVER (),0), 1) AS PERCENT_OF_LIST
FROM moira_students ms
GROUP BY ms.department_name
ORDER BY STUDENT_COUNT DESC

rows.question: Among the mailing lists subscribed by people with physical offices in building 24, provide the name of the most subscribed mailing list and the total number of subscribers.

WITH offices_in_bldg24 AS (

  WHERE ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '24%' OR ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '% 24%' OR ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '%/24%' OR ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = '24'

  JOIN moira_list m ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE COALESCE(m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, '') IN ('Y','1','T','TRUE','Yes','yes')
)
SELECT ms.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ms.MIT_ID) AS subscriber_count
FROM moira_subs ms
JOIN offices_in_bldg24 o ON ms.MIT_ID = o.MIT_ID
GROUP BY ms.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ms.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For email lists subscribed by either support staff or faculty, list its name, the number of subscribers that are support staff, the number of subscribers that are faculty, as well as its active status.

WITH list_subscriber_employee_types AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS ML_ID,
    m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS MEMBER,
    d.EMPLOYEE_TYPE AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE
  FROM moira_list_detail AS m
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory AS d
    ON d.MIT_ID = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
),
moira_mailing_lists AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS ML_ID,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS ML_NAME,
    IS_ACTIVE AS ML_ACTIVE
  FROM moira_list
  WHERE IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
     OR IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'Y'
     OR IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'true'  -- tolerate alternate representations if present
     OR IS_MOIRA_GROUP = 'true'
)
SELECT
  m.ML_NAME AS list_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS support_staff_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faculty_count,

LEFT JOIN list_subscriber_employee_types l

rows.question: For the 'ocean-apple' mailing list, identify the department with the highest student count. Provide the department name, phone number, and the total number of students subscribed to the mailing list from that department. If multiple departments have the same highest count, list each one separately.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
person_student_status AS (
  -- canonical person rows with indicators of student status and carrying IDs/identifiers
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sd.FULL_NAME, se.FULL_NAME, opc.FULL_NAME) AS uid,
    COALESCE(se.MIT_ID, opc.MIT_ID, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS person_id,
    opc.KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE AS username,
    sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email,
    sd.DEPARTMENT AS sd_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sd_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- consider someone a student if they appear in the student directory or student_degree_program
    CASE
      WHEN sd.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'STUDENT'
      WHEN sdp.DEGREE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'STUDENT'
      ELSE 'NON-STUDENT'
    END AS affiliation
  FROM mit_student_directory sd
  LEFT JOIN se_person se
    ON sd.FULL_NAME = se.FULL_NAME
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current opc
    ON (se.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND se.MIT_ID = opc.MIT_ID)
    OR (sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = opc.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
  LEFT JOIN student_degree_program sdp
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT = sdp.DEPARTMENT
  -- include moira_list_detail in a lateral fashion to allow matching by MIT_ID when student row lacks person links
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = COALESCE(se.MIT_ID, opc.MIT_ID)
),
moira_list_subscribers_filtered AS (
  -- subscribers for 'ocean-apple' with member identifier and MIT_ID where present
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS member_identifier,
    NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') AS member_mit_id,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple'
),
person_to_department_map AS (
  -- map students (from student directory) to department codes; carry department name
  SELECT
    sd.FULL_NAME AS uid,
    sd.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    sd.OFFICE_PHONE AS office_phone,
    sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS email_address
  FROM mit_student_directory sd
  WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT <> ''
),
subscribers_mapped AS (
  -- Attempt to map each moira subscriber to a student by MIT_ID, email, or full name, prefer MIT_ID then email then name
  SELECT
    m.*,
    pst.uid AS mapped_uid,
    pst.department_code,
    pst.department_name,
    pst.office_phone
  FROM moira_list_subscribers_filtered m
  LEFT JOIN person_student_status p
    ON (m.member_mit_id IS NOT NULL AND p.person_id = m.member_mit_id)
    OR (m.member_identifier IS NOT NULL AND p.username IS NOT NULL AND m.member_identifier = p.username)
    OR (m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND p.uid = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME)
  LEFT JOIN person_to_department_map pst
    ON pst.uid = p.uid
  -- Also try mapping directly by email or full name to student directory if prior join failed
  UNION
  SELECT
    m.*,
    pt.uid AS mapped_uid,
    pt.department_code,
    pt.department_name,
    pt.office_phone
  FROM moira_list_subscribers_filtered m
  LEFT JOIN person_to_department_map pt
    ON (m.member_mit_id IS NOT NULL AND pt.email_address IS NOT NULL AND m.member_mit_id = pt.email_address) -- unlikely but safe
    OR (m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND pt.uid = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME)
),
distinct_student_subscriptions AS (
  -- produce distinct students (by mapped_uid OR member_mit_id OR member_identifier/email) with their department
  SELECT
    COALESCE(mapped_uid, member_mit_id, member_identifier, MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME) AS student_key,
    department_code,
    department_name,
    office_phone
  FROM subscribers_mapped
  WHERE (department_code IS NOT NULL AND department_code <> '')
),
dept_counts AS (
  -- count distinct students per department
  SELECT
    department_code,
    department_name,
    office_phone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT student_key) AS student_count
  FROM distinct_student_subscriptions
  GROUP BY department_code, department_name, office_phone
)
-- final: return departments that tie for the highest student_count, with phone normalized using sis_admin_department when available
SELECT
  dc.department_name AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- Prefer office_phone from student directory; else use sis_admin_department phone fields if available
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dc.office_phone, ''),
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ''), '') <> '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ''), '') <> '' THEN '-' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, '')
    ),
    ''
  ) AS OFFICE_PHONE,
  dc.student_count AS STUDENT_COUNT
FROM dept_counts dc
LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.department_code
WHERE dc.student_count = (SELECT MAX(student_count) FROM dept_counts)
ORDER BY dc.department_name

rows.question: For each mailing group, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_group_membership_rows AS (
  SELECT
    -- carry through the required owner fields by joining to moira_list_owner
    dlo.`OWNER`                       AS `OWNER`,
    dlo.`OWNER_TYPE`                  AS `OWNER_TYPE`,
    ml.`IS_PUBLIC`                    AS `IS_PUBLIC`,
    dld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`           AS `MEMBER`,
    -- grain identity: construct a row identifier from the detail table
    CONCAT(dld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, '::', dld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) AS `ROWID`
  FROM
    `moira_list_detail` dld
    LEFT JOIN `moira_list_owner` dlo
      ON dld.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY` = dlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
    LEFT JOIN `moira_list` ml
      ON dld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
)
SELECT
  OWNER AS owner,
  OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  CASE WHEN IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM moira_group_membership_rows
WHERE IS_PUBLIC IN ('Y','N')
GROUP BY OWNER, OWNER_TYPE, CASE WHEN IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END

UNION ALL

SELECT
  OWNER AS owner,
  OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  NULL AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM moira_group_membership_rows
WHERE IS_PUBLIC IN ('Y','N')
GROUP BY OWNER, OWNER_TYPE
ORDER BY owner ASC, owner_type ASC, 
  -- ensure the NULL grand-total row sorts last for each owner/owner_type
  CASE WHEN member_visibility IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  member_visibility ASC

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biology_course_sections AS (
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  NULL AS SUBJECT_LEVEL,
  so.CLUSTER_TYPE AS SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  so.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  so.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS ENROLLMENT
FROM subject_offered AS so
WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
  AND so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
course_tip_materials AS (
SELECT
  tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY           AS TIP_MATERIAL_ID,
  tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE            AS TIP_MATERIAL_NEW_PRICE,
  tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE           AS TIP_MATERIAL_USED_PRICE,
  tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE       AS TIP_MATERIAL_SOURCE,
  tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY   AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
  tso.TERM_CODE                 AS SECTION_ID
FROM
  tip_material tm
  JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WHERE
  tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE IS NOT NULL
  AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE <> ''
  AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'TIP'
),
course_library_holdings AS (
SELECT
  lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_ID,
  lrc.`CATALOG_TITLE` AS TITLE,
  lrc.`CATALOG_ISBN` AS ISBN,
  lrm.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
  lrm.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY` AS SECTION_ID
FROM
  `library_reserve_catalog` AS lrc
JOIN
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail` AS lrm
    ON lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
)
SELECT
  bcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  bcs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  bcs.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  SUM(bcs.ENROLLMENT) AS total_enrollments,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT bcs.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(bcs.ENROLLMENT) / COUNT(DISTINCT bcs.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID)
  END AS avg_enrollment_in_cluster,
  bcs.SUBJECT_LEVEL AS course_level,
  COALESCE(tip_group.unique_materials, 0) AS unique_material_count,
  CASE WHEN tip_group.count_new_price_vals = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE tip_group.sum_new_price / tip_group.count_new_price_vals
  END AS avg_new_price_tip,
  CASE WHEN tip_group.count_used_price_vals = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE tip_group.sum_used_price / tip_group.count_used_price_vals
  END AS avg_used_price_tip,
  COALESCE(tip_group.record_count, 0) AS tip_material_record_count,
  COALESCE(lib_group.unique_titles, 0) AS unique_library_titles,
  COALESCE(lib_group.unique_isbns, 0) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM biology_course_sections bcs
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregate TIP measures at group (cluster_type + course_level) level by first aggregating per section
  SELECT
    ctm.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    ctm.SECTION_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_ID) AS sec_unique_materials,
    SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_NEW_PRICE) AS sec_sum_new_price,
    SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_USED_PRICE) AS sec_sum_used_price,
    SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_NEW_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS sec_count_new_price_vals,
    SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_USED_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS sec_count_used_price_vals,
    COUNT(*) AS sec_record_count
  FROM course_tip_materials ctm
  WHERE ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_SOURCE = 'TIP'
  GROUP BY ctm.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID, ctm.SECTION_ID
) tip_sec ON tip_sec.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = bcs.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID AND tip_sec.SECTION_ID = bcs.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregate library measures at section level
  SELECT
    ch.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    ch.SECTION_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(ch.TITLE, '')) AS sec_unique_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(ch.ISBN, '')) AS sec_unique_isbns
  FROM course_library_holdings ch
  GROUP BY ch.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID, ch.SECTION_ID
) lib_sec ON lib_sec.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = bcs.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID AND lib_sec.SECTION_ID = bcs.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN (
  -- roll up TIP section aggregates to the final grouping keys by joining back to biology_course_sections to get cluster/level
  SELECT
    b.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
    b.SUBJECT_LEVEL,
    SUM(sec.sec_unique_materials) AS unique_materials,
    SUM(sec.sec_sum_new_price) AS sum_new_price,
    SUM(sec.sec_sum_used_price) AS sum_used_price,
    SUM(sec.sec_count_new_price_vals) AS count_new_price_vals,
    SUM(sec.sec_count_used_price_vals) AS count_used_price_vals,
    SUM(sec.sec_record_count) AS record_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ctm.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
      ctm.SECTION_ID,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_ID) AS sec_unique_materials,
      SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_NEW_PRICE) AS sec_sum_new_price,
      SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_USED_PRICE) AS sec_sum_used_price,
      SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_NEW_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS sec_count_new_price_vals,
      SUM(ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_USED_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS sec_count_used_price_vals,
      COUNT(*) AS sec_record_count
    FROM course_tip_materials ctm
    WHERE ctm.TIP_MATERIAL_SOURCE = 'TIP'
    GROUP BY ctm.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID, ctm.SECTION_ID
  ) sec
  JOIN biology_course_sections b
    ON b.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = sec.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID
   AND b.SECTION_ID = sec.SECTION_ID
  GROUP BY b.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE, b.SUBJECT_LEVEL
) tip_group ON tip_group.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE = bcs.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AND tip_group.SUBJECT_LEVEL = bcs.SUBJECT_LEVEL
LEFT JOIN (
  -- roll up library section aggregates to the final grouping keys
  SELECT
    b.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
    b.SUBJECT_LEVEL,
    SUM(lib.sec_unique_titles) AS unique_titles,
    SUM(lib.sec_unique_isbns) AS unique_isbns
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ch.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
      ch.SECTION_ID,
      COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(ch.TITLE, '')) AS sec_unique_titles,
      COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(ch.ISBN, '')) AS sec_unique_isbns
    FROM course_library_holdings ch
    GROUP BY ch.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID, ch.SECTION_ID
  ) lib
  JOIN biology_course_sections b
    ON b.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = lib.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID
   AND b.SECTION_ID = lib.SECTION_ID
  GROUP BY b.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE, b.SUBJECT_LEVEL
) lib_group ON lib_group.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE = bcs.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AND lib_group.SUBJECT_LEVEL = bcs.SUBJECT_LEVEL
GROUP BY
  bcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  bcs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  bcs.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  bcs.SUBJECT_LEVEL,
  tip_group.unique_materials,
  tip_group.sum_new_price,
  tip_group.sum_used_price,
  tip_group.count_new_price_vals,
  tip_group.count_used_price_vals,
  tip_group.record_count,
  lib_group.unique_titles,
  lib_group.unique_isbns
ORDER BY total_enrollments DESC
