SELECT
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR` AS `IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM` AS `IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM` AS `IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`FALL_INSTRUCTORS` AS `FALL_INSTRUCTORS`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` AS `SPRING_INSTRUCTORS`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TOTAL_UNITS` AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`
FROM
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`
)
SELECT
  dd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  NULL AS school_name,
  osc.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  osc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  -- course_level: take leading digits from SUBJECT_NUMBER if present, else NULL
  NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(osc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'), '') AS course_level,
  osc.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units,
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(COALESCE(osc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, osc.TERM_CODE), 2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN RIGHT(COALESCE(osc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, osc.TERM_CODE), 2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
    ELSE CASE
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM <> 'Y' THEN 'Fall'
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' AND osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM <> 'Y' THEN 'Spring'
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall'
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring'
           ELSE NULL
         END
  END AS term,
  atl.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE WHEN RIGHT(sic.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' THEN 1*sic.FALL_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT_OVERRIDE ELSE 0 END
  ),0) AS fall_instructor_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE WHEN RIGHT(sic.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP' THEN 1*sic.SPRING_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT_OVERRIDE ELSE 0 END
  ),0) AS spring_instructor_count
FROM offered_subjects_catalog AS osc
LEFT JOIN department_directory AS dd
  ON osc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dd.ORG_CODE
LEFT JOIN academic_term_lookup AS atl
  ON COALESCE(osc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, osc.TERM_CODE) = atl.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- prepare instructor counts per subject+term, mapping available columns from the provided view
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    TERM_CODE,
    -- subject_instructor_counts_by_term view already provides a distinct-count of instructor names;
    -- to avoid name collision, refer to its provided columns (we assume the view exposes an instructor count column;
    -- if not, we map counts by counting distinct from FALL_INSTRUCTORS/SPRING_INSTRUCTORS text fields)
    -- Since the view cols are: SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    -- produce numeric counts by splitting text on comma or semicolon.
    -- Use a simple heuristic: count commas+1 when non-null, else 0.
    -- We'll output counts into two separate columns for joining aggregation below.
    SUBJECT_ID AS si_subject_id,
    TERM_CODE AS si_term_code,
    -- count fall instructors text if present
    (CASE
       WHEN FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN 0
       ELSE CHAR_LENGTH(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')) + 1
     END) AS FALL_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT_OVERRIDE,
    (CASE
       WHEN SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN 0
       ELSE CHAR_LENGTH(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', '')) + 1
     END) AS SPRING_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT_OVERRIDE
  FROM subject_instructor_counts_by_term
) AS sic
  ON sic.SUBJECT_ID = osc.SUBJECT_ID
  -- match term code where sic term corresponds to the offered subject's term/year when possible
  AND (
       RIGHT(sic.TERM_CODE,2) = RIGHT(COALESCE(osc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, osc.TERM_CODE),2)
       OR RIGHT(sic.TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP') -- include counts for both seasons for the subject
      )
WHERE
  osc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  AND (osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
GROUP BY
  dd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  osc.SUBJECT_ID,
  osc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  REGEXP_SUBSTR(osc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'),
  osc.TOTAL_UNITS,
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(COALESCE(osc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, osc.TERM_CODE), 2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN RIGHT(COALESCE(osc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, osc.TERM_CODE), 2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
    ELSE CASE
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM <> 'Y' THEN 'Fall'
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' AND osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM <> 'Y' THEN 'Spring'
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Fall'
           WHEN osc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring'
           ELSE NULL
         END
  END,
  atl.TERM_DESCRIPTION

rows.question: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_to_department_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS `HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    c.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` AS c
  WHERE c.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Political Science'
    AND c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` IS NOT NULL
    AND c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` <> ''
  GROUP BY
    c.`SUBJECT_ID`, c.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`, c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`
),
-- representative subject row (one per SUBJECT_ID) from catalogs to get title/description and units
subject_catalog_basic AS (
  SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    s.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    s.TOTAL_UNITS,
    s.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cc.SUBJECT_ID,
      cc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
      cc.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
      cc.TOTAL_UNITS,
      cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cc.SUBJECT_ID
        ORDER BY
          (CASE WHEN cc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) DESC,
          cc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC,
          (CASE WHEN cc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) DESC,
          cc.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
      ) rn
    FROM `cis_course_catalog` cc
    WHERE cc.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  ) s
  WHERE s.rn = 1
),
-- attempt to get enrollment per subject from subject_offered_summary or subject_offered if present
subject_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS subject_enrollment_sum
  FROM `subject_offered_summary` sos
  WHERE sos.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CAST(NULLIF(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, '') AS SIGNED), 0)) AS subject_enrollment_sum
  FROM `subject_offered` so
  WHERE so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- consolidate enrollment per subject (take greatest available to avoid double counting)
subject_enrollment_consolidated AS (
  SELECT
    se.SUBJECT_ID,
    MAX(se.subject_enrollment_sum) AS subject_enrollment_sum
  FROM subject_enrollment se
  GROUP BY se.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- department degree info
department_degree_flag AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM `sis_department` sd
)
SELECT
  stm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  -- description of the HASS attribute: use the catalog's HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC if available; cis_course_catalog has HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC in other tables,
  -- but we used cis_course_catalog which may not have a separate desc column in this schema: so pick the most common SUBJECT_TITLE as representative description per attribute
  MAX(scb.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  COUNT(DISTINCT scb.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  -- average TOTAL_UNITS across distinct subjects (exclude nulls)
  AVG(scb.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  -- total enrollment: sum of per-subject enrollment (treat missing as 0)
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(sec.subject_enrollment_sum, 0)), 0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  -- number of distinct degree-granting departments offering those subjects
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ddf.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN stm.DEPARTMENT_CODE END) AS NUM_DEGREE_GRANTING_DEPARTMENTS,
  -- subject code description: aggregate distinct subject titles concatenated per HASS attribute (comma-separated)
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT scb.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY scb.SUBJECT_TITLE SEPARATOR '; ') AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESCRIPTION
FROM subject_to_department_mapping stm
JOIN subject_catalog_basic scb
  ON scb.SUBJECT_ID = stm.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN subject_enrollment_consolidated sec
  ON sec.SUBJECT_ID = scb.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN department_degree_flag ddf
  ON ddf.DEPARTMENT_CODE = stm.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE stm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
  AND stm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
  AND stm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
GROUP BY stm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
ORDER BY NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS DESC

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE, dcc.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS cluster_type,
  COALESCE(dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS department_name,
  COALESCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
  COALESCE(sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
           CASE WHEN hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE NULL END) AS department_grants_degrees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dcc.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dcc.SUBJECT_ID) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / COUNT(DISTINCT dcc.SUBJECT_ID), 2)
  END AS average_enrollment
FROM drupal_course_catalog dcc
JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
  ON sos.TERM_CODE = dcc.TERM_CODE
  AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = dcc.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN subject_offered sod
  ON sod.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE
  AND sod.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
  ON fo.D_CODE = dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN hr_org_unit hou
  ON (hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD)
     OR (hou.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND hou.DLC_KEY = fo.MAJOR_ORG_KEY)
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE, dcc.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES, 'UNSPECIFIED'),
  COALESCE(dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME),
  COALESCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME),
  COALESCE(sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
           CASE WHEN hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE NULL END)
HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0
ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_section_meetings AS (
SELECT
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_PLACE` AS `MEET_PLACE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_TIME` AS `MEET_TIME`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TOTAL_UNITS` AS `TOTAL_UNITS`
FROM
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`
WHERE
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_PLACE` IS NOT NULL
  AND `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_TIME` IS NOT NULL
),
room_properties AS (
SELECT
  fr.ROOM                                AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY                         AS BLDG_NUMBER,
  fr.DEPT_CODE                            AS DEPT_CODE,
  fr.MINOR_USE_DESC                       AS ROOM_TYPE,
  fr.AREA                                 AS ROOM_AREA,
  fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME                   AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM fac_rooms AS fr
LEFT JOIN fac_organization AS fo
  ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
building_attributes AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME                  AS BLDG_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER                AS BLDG_NUMBER,
  addr.CITY                        AS BLDG_CITY,
  addr.STATE                       AS BLDG_STATE,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE      AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM buildings AS b
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address AS addr
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = addr.BUILDING_KEY
  AND addr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'PRIMARY'
)
SELECT
  agg.room_number AS room_number,
  ba.BLDG_NAME AS building_name,
  agg.building_number AS building_number,
  ba.BLDG_CITY AS building_city,
  ba.BLDG_STATE AS building_state,
  COALESCE(rp.ROOM_AREA, ba.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, ba.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS area,
  rp.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS organization_name,
  rp.ROOM_TYPE AS room_usage,
  agg.term_code AS term_code,
  CASE
    WHEN agg.course_level_digit REGEXP '^[1-4]$' THEN 'Undergraduate'
    WHEN agg.course_level_digit REGEXP '^[5-9]$' THEN 'Graduate'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS course_level,
  agg.total_subjects AS total_subjects,
  agg.unique_meeting_times AS unique_meeting_times,
  agg.total_units AS total_units
FROM (
  -- aggregate meeting-level rows to course/section level while preserving parsed building/room
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    c.SECTION_ID AS section_id,
    -- parse MEET_PLACE expecting format "BLDGNNN ROOM" or "BLDGNNN/ROOM" or "BLDGNNN-ROOM"
    -- attempt extract building_number = substring before first non-alnum separator, room_number = last token
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.MEET_PLACE,'/',' '),'-',' '),' ',1)) AS building_number,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.MEET_PLACE,'/',' '),'-',' '),' ',-1)) AS room_number,
    -- course level digit: leading digit(s) of SUBJECT_NUMBER
    TRIM(LEFT(c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,1)) AS course_level_digit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.MEET_TIME) AS unique_meeting_times,
    -- total_units: sum distinct TOTAL_UNITS for the section (handles multiple meeting rows)
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT c.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS total_units
  FROM course_section_meetings c
  GROUP BY
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.SECTION_ID,
    building_number,
    room_number,
    course_level_digit
) AS agg
LEFT JOIN room_properties rp
  ON rp.BLDG_NUMBER = agg.building_number
  AND rp.ROOM_NUMBER = agg.room_number
LEFT JOIN building_attributes ba
  ON ba.BLDG_NUMBER = agg.building_number

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH departments_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORG_ID,
    NULLIF(TRIM(fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), '') AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM fac_organization fo
),
catalog_item_to_courses AS (
  SELECT
    lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS CATALOG_ID,
    lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS COURSE_OFFERED_KEY,
    lrm.TERM_CODE AS TERM_ID
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
),
course_section_enrollments AS (
  -- use subject_offered rows as the enrollment source (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE AS TERM,
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS COURSE_OFFERED_KEY,
    COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) AS ENROLLED
  FROM subject_offered
),
library_catalog_items_post2000 AS (
  SELECT
    c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS CATALOG_ID,
    c.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE AS CATALOG_DATE_RAW,
    -- normalize material status text
    m.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    -- prefer department name from library_subject_offered (if present)
    NULLIF(TRIM(s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- also keep catalog key for joins
    c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  FROM library_reserve_catalog c
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail d
    ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered s
    ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status m
    ON m.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE
    -- accept either an ISO date string or at least a year >= 2000 in the string
    (
      -- direct lexicographic compare works for YYYY-MM-DD format
      (c.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL
        AND c.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
      -- or try to parse a year from the string (fallback)
      OR (
        c.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(LEFT(c.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE,4) AS SIGNED) >= 2000
      )
    )
),
-- compute enrollments per catalog item by joining catalog->course_offered_key->enrollments
catalog_item_enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    ci.CATALOG_ID,
    COALESCE(SUM(cs.ENROLLED),0) AS ENROLLED_SUM
  FROM library_catalog_items_post2000 ci
  LEFT JOIN catalog_item_to_courses ct
    ON ct.CATALOG_ID = ci.CATALOG_ID
  LEFT JOIN course_section_enrollments cs
    ON cs.TERM = ct.TERM_ID
   AND cs.COURSE_OFFERED_KEY = ct.COURSE_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY ci.CATALOG_ID
)
SELECT
  material_status AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  department_name AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  CAST(number_of_catalog_items AS UNSIGNED) AS NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS,
  CAST(total_enrolled_students AS UNSIGNED) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  -- detail rows per material_status + department_name
  SELECT
    l.MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COALESCE(l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.CATALOG_ID) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.ENROLLED_SUM),0) AS total_enrolled_students,
    1 AS sort_group,
    l.MATERIAL_STATUS AS sort_status,
    COALESCE(l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS sort_dept
  FROM library_catalog_items_post2000 l
  LEFT JOIN catalog_item_enrollments e
    ON e.CATALOG_ID = l.CATALOG_ID
  GROUP BY l.MATERIAL_STATUS, COALESCE(l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown')

  UNION ALL

  -- subtotal rows per material_status
  SELECT
    material_status,
    'All Departments' AS department_name,
    SUM(number_of_catalog_items) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students,
    2 AS sort_group,
    material_status AS sort_status,
    NULL AS sort_dept
  FROM (
    SELECT
      l.MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
      COALESCE(l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT l.CATALOG_ID) AS number_of_catalog_items,
      COALESCE(SUM(e.ENROLLED_SUM),0) AS total_enrolled_students
    FROM library_catalog_items_post2000 l
    LEFT JOIN catalog_item_enrollments e
      ON e.CATALOG_ID = l.CATALOG_ID
    GROUP BY l.MATERIAL_STATUS, COALESCE(l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown')
  ) t
  GROUP BY material_status

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total row
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    'All Departments' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.CATALOG_ID) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.ENROLLED_SUM),0) AS total_enrolled_students,
    3 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS sort_status,
    NULL AS sort_dept
  FROM library_catalog_items_post2000 l
  LEFT JOIN catalog_item_enrollments e
    ON e.CATALOG_ID = l.CATALOG_ID
) combined
ORDER BY
  -- ensure statuses are grouped (NULL/Grand Total at end)
  CASE WHEN sort_status IS NULL THEN 'ZZZ' ELSE sort_status END,
  sort_group,
  sort_dept

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_enrollment_by_section AS (
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  so.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_ID,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS ENROLLMENT
FROM subject_offered so
)
SELECT
  department,
  total_courses_using_library_materials,
  number_of_catalog_items,
  average_enrollment_per_course
FROM (
  -- per-department aggregates
  SELECT
    COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cebs.DEPT_CODE, 'Unknown') AS department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    AVG(c.enrollment_sum) AS average_enrollment_per_course
  FROM (
    -- aggregate enrollment to course-grain (subject + term if available)
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
      TERM_ID AS term_id,
      DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
      SUM(ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_sum
    FROM course_enrollment_by_section
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_ID, DEPT_CODE
    HAVING SUM(ENROLLMENT) > 0
  ) AS c
  JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c.subject_id
    AND lso.TERM_CODE = c.term_id
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrmd.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
    AND lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN course_enrollment_by_section cebs
    ON cebs.SUBJECT_ID = c.subject_id AND cebs.TERM_ID = c.term_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cebs.DEPT_CODE, 'Unknown')

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total row
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.subject_id) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    AVG(c.enrollment_sum) AS average_enrollment_per_course
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
      TERM_ID AS term_id,
      SUM(ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_sum
    FROM course_enrollment_by_section
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_ID
    HAVING SUM(ENROLLMENT) > 0
  ) AS c
  JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c.subject_id
    AND lso.TERM_CODE = c.term_id
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrmd.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
    AND lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
) t
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN department = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  department

rows.question: For each department and school offering courses with materials, list the department name, school name, number of unique course materials, number of courses, average new and used shelf prices of materials, total material records, and number of distinct material statuses. Include a grand total across all schools and departments (the corresponding school and department fields should be null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH courses_with_materials_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
),
materials_for_courses AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS MATERIAL_ID,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE AS USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    -- keep detail row identifier so we can count material records
    CONCAT(td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, '::', td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, '::', IFNULL(td.TERM_CODE,''), '::', IFNULL(td.ISBN,'')) AS MATERIAL_DETAIL_ID
  FROM tip_detail td
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
)
SELECT
  c.department_name,
  c.school_name,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.MATERIAL_ID) AS SIGNED) AS num_unique_materials,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID) AS SIGNED) AS num_courses,
  AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  CAST(COUNT(m.MATERIAL_DETAIL_ID) AS SIGNED) AS total_material_records,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.MATERIAL_STATUS) AS SIGNED) AS num_distinct_material_statuses
FROM courses_with_materials_cohort c
LEFT JOIN materials_for_courses m
  ON c.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = m.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID
GROUP BY c.department_name, c.school_name

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS department_name,
  NULL AS school_name,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.MATERIAL_ID) AS SIGNED) AS num_unique_materials,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID) AS SIGNED) AS num_courses,
  AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  CAST(COUNT(m.MATERIAL_DETAIL_ID) AS SIGNED) AS total_material_records,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.MATERIAL_STATUS) AS SIGNED) AS num_distinct_material_statuses
FROM courses_with_materials_cohort c
LEFT JOIN materials_for_courses m
  ON c.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID = m.SUBJECT_OFFERED_ID

ORDER BY
  (school_name IS NULL), school_name ASC,
  (department_name IS NULL), department_name ASC

rows.question: For each TIP material status, list the total number of unique materials associated with the status, the total number of records associated with the status, and the total student enrollment associated with the status. Any material status with null values should be displayed as 'No material status'. Additionally, include a grand total across all material status (the material status for this row should be displayed as 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_material_status_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS MATERIAL_ID,
    COALESCE(s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'No material status') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS STUDENT_ENROLLMENT,
    -- carry join keys / record id for grain and joinability
    m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS RECORD_ID,
    m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM tip_material m
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail d
    ON m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status s
    ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered so
    ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
)
SELECT
  t.MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.MATERIAL_ID) AS UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS RECORD_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(t.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT), 0) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
FROM tip_material_status_canonical t
LEFT JOIN tip_detail d
  ON t.MATERIAL_ID = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY t.MATERIAL_STATUS

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.MATERIAL_ID) AS UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS RECORD_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(t.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT), 0) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
FROM tip_material_status_canonical t
LEFT JOIN tip_detail d
  ON t.MATERIAL_ID = d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

ORDER BY
  -- ensure 'Grand Total' is last; all other statuses ordered ascending
  CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  MATERIAL_STATUS ASC

rows.question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_total_area_and_room_count AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_ID,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(fr.AREA,0)), 0) AS AREA,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fr.AREA IS NULL AND fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN 1
             WHEN fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ROOM_COUNT
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME
),
floor_total_area_and_room_count_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY   AS BUILDING_ID,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '') AS FLOOR_NUM,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(fr.AREA,0)), 0) AS AREA,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ROOM_COUNT
  FROM fac_building fb
  JOIN fac_rooms fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '')
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(AREA) AS TOTAL_AREA, SUM(ROOM_COUNT) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
  FROM building_total_area_and_room_count
)
SELECT
  ROW_TYPE,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  FLOOR_NUMBER,
  ROOM_NUMBER,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  ROOM_COUNT,
  AREA,
  AREA_PERCENTAGE
FROM (
  -- Detail rows
  SELECT
    'detail' AS ROW_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '') AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(fr.ROOM, '') AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_TYPE, '') AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    FORMAT(ROUND(1),0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(fr.AREA,0)),0) AS AREA,
    CONCAT(
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          CASE WHEN COALESCE(bt.AREA,0) = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE 100.0 * COALESCE(fr.AREA,0) / bt.AREA
          END
        ,2)
      ,2),
    '%') AS AREA_PERCENTAGE,
    -- ordering helpers
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS o_building,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR,'') AS o_floor,
    COALESCE(fr.ROOM,'') AS o_room,
    1 AS sort_group,
    COALESCE(bt.AREA,0) AS building_area,
    NULL AS floor_area
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  JOIN fac_building b ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN building_total_area_and_room_count bt
    ON bt.BUILDING_ID = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE NOT (fr.AREA IS NULL AND fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NULL) -- include rooms even if AREA is NULL (treated as 0)
  
  UNION ALL

  -- Floor subtotals
  SELECT
    'floor_subtotal' AS ROW_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    f.FLOOR_NUM AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    '' AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    '' AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    FORMAT(ROUND(f.ROOM_COUNT),0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(f.AREA,0)),0) AS AREA,
    CONCAT(
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          CASE WHEN COALESCE(bt.AREA,0) = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE 100.0 * COALESCE(f.AREA,0) / bt.AREA
          END
        ,2)
      ,2),
    '%') AS AREA_PERCENTAGE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS o_building,
    f.FLOOR_NUM AS o_floor,
    '~~FLOOR_SUBTOTAL~~' AS o_room,
    2 AS sort_group,
    COALESCE(bt.AREA,0) AS building_area,
    COALESCE(f.AREA,0) AS floor_area
  FROM floor_total_area_and_room_count_per_building f
  JOIN fac_building b ON f.BUILDING_ID = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN building_total_area_and_room_count bt
    ON bt.BUILDING_ID = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  -- Building subtotals
  SELECT
    'building_subtotal' AS ROW_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    '' AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    '' AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_TYPE, '') AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    FORMAT(ROUND(bt.ROOM_COUNT),0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(bt.AREA,0)),0) AS AREA,
    CONCAT(
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          CASE WHEN g.TOTAL_AREA = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE 100.0 * COALESCE(bt.AREA,0) / g.TOTAL_AREA
          END
        ,2)
      ,2),
    '%') AS AREA_PERCENTAGE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS o_building,
    '~~BUILDING_SUBTOTAL~~' AS o_floor,
    '~~BUILDING_SUBTOTAL~~' AS o_room,
    3 AS sort_group,
    COALESCE(bt.AREA,0) AS building_area,
    NULL AS floor_area
  FROM building_total_area_and_room_count bt
  JOIN fac_building b ON bt.BUILDING_ID = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  CROSS JOIN grand_total g

  UNION ALL

  -- Grand total
  SELECT
    'grand_total' AS ROW_TYPE,
    'ALL BUILDINGS' AS BUILDING_NAME,
    '' AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    '' AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    '' AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    FORMAT(ROUND(g.TOTAL_ROOMS),0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(g.TOTAL_AREA,0)),0) AS AREA,
    CONCAT(
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          CASE WHEN g.TOTAL_AREA = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 END
        ,2)
      ,2),
    '%') AS AREA_PERCENTAGE,
    '~~ALL~~' AS o_building,
    '~~ALL~~' AS o_floor,
    '~~ALL~~' AS o_room,
    4 AS sort_group,
    g.TOTAL_AREA AS building_area,
    NULL AS floor_area
  FROM grand_total g
) AS combined
ORDER BY
  -- primary: building name ascending, but place grand total last via sort_group
  CASE WHEN sort_group = 4 THEN CHAR(255) ELSE o_building END ASC,
  -- within a building: for details (sort_group=1) order by floor then room; floor subtotal (2) comes after its details; building subtotal (3) after all floors
  CASE WHEN sort_group = 1 THEN o_floor
       WHEN sort_group = 2 THEN o_floor
       ELSE o_floor END ASC,
  sort_group ASC,
  CASE WHEN sort_group = 1 THEN o_room ELSE o_room END ASC

rows.question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH distinct_term_parameters_per_term AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_PARAMETER`
  FROM `academic_term_parameter`
  GROUP BY
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_PARAMETER`
),
terms_with_academic_and_fin_aid_year AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `TERM_START_DATE`,
    `TERM_END_DATE`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR` IS NOT NULL
    AND `FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR` <> ''
    AND `ACADEMIC_YEAR` IS NOT NULL
    AND `ACADEMIC_YEAR` <> ''
)
SELECT
  t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  -- count distinct fiscal periods from time_month linked by FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR and ACADEMIC_YEAR
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS fiscal_period_count,
  -- count distinct quarters from time_month (FY_QUARTER_CODE) linked by FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR and ACADEMIC_YEAR
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS quarter_count,
  -- earliest term start and latest term end among terms for the group
  MIN(t.TERM_START_DATE) AS term_start_date,
  MAX(t.TERM_END_DATE) AS term_end_date,
  -- distinct TERM_PARAMETER values for TERM_CODEs that belong to this FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR/ACADEMIC_YEAR
  COUNT(DISTINCT dtp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS distinct_department_term_parameter_count
FROM (
  -- derive one row per FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR / ACADEMIC_YEAR to group on
  SELECT
    FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR
  FROM terms_with_academic_and_fin_aid_year
  GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR
) AS years
JOIN terms_with_academic_and_fin_aid_year t
  ON t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = years.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
 AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = years.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN `time_month` tm
  ON tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = years.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
 AND tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = years.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN distinct_term_parameters_per_term dtp
  -- only consider TERM_PARAMETER entries whose TERM_CODE exists in the terms for this group
  ON dtp.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  years.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  years.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  years.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ASC,
  years.ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC

rows.question: Group buildings by campus sectors. For each group, list the campus sector, name of the building, city and state where the building is located, total number of floors, total assignable area, total number of rooms, total number of organizations, ownership type, and a rank column indicating the order (1-indexed) of this row within each sector based on the descending order of assignable area. Include subtotals for each sector and a grand total across all sectors. The subtotal and grand total only need to computed over the total number of floors and assignable area.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_canonical_addresses AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fba.STREET_NUMBER AS ADDRESS_LINE1,
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '' AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END
    ) AS ADDRESS_LINE2,
    fba.CITY AS CITY,
    fba.STATE AS STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE
  FROM fclt_building b
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba
    ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    AND (fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE IS NULL OR fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'PRIMARY')
),
building_room_counts AS (
  -- count rooms and distinct organizations per building from fclt_rooms
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS DISTINCT_ORG_COUNT
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
buildings_normalized AS (
  -- primary building list is the 'buildings' table as requested.
  -- Join to fclt_building / fac_building / addresses where helpful for sector, ownership, city/state.
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fac.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    -- campus sector: prefer fclt_building.CAMPUS_SECTOR, then fac_building.CAMPUS_SECTOR, else 'UNSPECIFIED'
    COALESCE(fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR, fac.CAMPUS_SECTOR, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS BUILDING_SECTOR,
    -- city/state: prefer canonical address city/state, else NULL
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    ca.CITY AS BUILDING_CITY,
    ca.STATE AS BUILDING_STATE,
    -- numeric metrics: treat NULL as 0
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_COUNTER, 0) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
    COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS TOTAL_GROSS_AREA,
    COALESCE(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, fac.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, NULL) AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
    ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fac
    ON fac.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  LEFT JOIN building_canonical_addresses ca
    ON ca.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
,
building_metrics AS (
  -- attach room/org counts and compute rank per sector
  SELECT
    bn.BUILDING_SECTOR,
    bn.BUILDING_KEY,
    bn.BUILDING_NAME,
    bn.BUILDING_CITY,
    bn.BUILDING_STATE,
    bn.TOTAL_FLOORS,
    bn.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    COALESCE(brc.ROOM_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
    COALESCE(brc.DISTINCT_ORG_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
    bn.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY bn.BUILDING_SECTOR
      ORDER BY bn.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA DESC
    ) AS SECTOR_RANK
  FROM buildings_normalized bn
  LEFT JOIN building_room_counts brc
    ON brc.BUILDING_KEY = bn.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  bm.BUILDING_SECTOR AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  bm.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  bm.BUILDING_CITY AS CITY,
  bm.BUILDING_STATE AS STATE,
  bm.TOTAL_FLOORS AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
  bm.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  bm.TOTAL_ROOMS AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
  bm.TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
  bm.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  bm.SECTOR_RANK AS SECTOR_RANK
FROM building_metrics bm

UNION ALL

-- SUBTOTAL rows per sector: sum TOTAL_FLOORS and TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA; other fields NULL as requested
SELECT
  sector AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  'SUBTOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME,
  NULL AS CITY,
  NULL AS STATE,
  SUM(TOTAL_FLOORS) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
  SUM(TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  NULL AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
  NULL AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  NULL AS SECTOR_RANK
FROM (
  SELECT BUILDING_SECTOR AS sector, TOTAL_FLOORS, TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM building_metrics
) s
GROUP BY sector

UNION ALL

-- GRAND TOTAL row
SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME,
  NULL AS CITY,
  NULL AS STATE,
  SUM(TOTAL_FLOORS) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
  SUM(TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  NULL AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
  NULL AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
  NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  NULL AS SECTOR_RANK
FROM building_metrics

ORDER BY
  -- ensure GRAND TOTAL is last
  CASE WHEN CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 'ZZZZZZZZ' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END ASC,
  -- within each sector, list building rows by SECTOR_RANK, then the SUBTOTAL (NULL rank appears last)
  CASE WHEN SECTOR_RANK IS NULL THEN 999999 ELSE SECTOR_RANK END ASC,
  -- tie-breaker to make ordering deterministic
  BUILDING_NAME ASC

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.

WITH tip_material_records AS (
  SELECT
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tm.TITLE AS TIP_TITLE,
    tm.AUTHOR AS TIP_AUTHOR,
    tm.ISBN AS TIP_ISBN,
    td.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    -- department info from course catalog, tip_subject_offered, or library_subject_offered
    COALESCE(cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    -- instructor id/name (may be null)
    COALESCE(cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_ID_OR_NAME,
    -- determine availability: consider a material available if it matches a library_reserve_catalog record (by ISBN)
    CASE WHEN lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IN_LIBRARY_RESERVES
  FROM tip_material tm
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cc
    ON cc.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
    AND cc.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = tm.ISBN
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
    ON lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    AND (lrm.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE OR lrm.TERM_CODE IS NULL)
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  WHERE tm.TITLE IS NOT NULL OR tm.ISBN IS NOT NULL
),
dept_library_materials AS (
  -- per department, distinct available materials (by ISBN if present else title)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS department_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(TIP_ISBN,''), TIP_TITLE)) AS total_library_materials_per_department
  FROM tip_material_records
  WHERE IN_LIBRARY_RESERVES = '1'
  GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown'), COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')
),
book_instructor_counts AS (
  -- for each department + book, count distinct instructors (by id or name)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS department_code,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TIP_ISBN,''), TIP_TITLE) AS book_identifier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_ID_OR_NAME,''), 'UNKNOWN_INSTRUCTOR')) AS instructors_per_library_book
  FROM tip_material_records
  WHERE IN_LIBRARY_RESERVES = '1'
  GROUP BY COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown'), COALESCE(DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(TIP_ISBN,''), TIP_TITLE)
),
total_available AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(TIP_ISBN,''), TIP_TITLE)) AS total_available_materials_all_departments
  FROM tip_material_records
  WHERE IN_LIBRARY_RESERVES = '1'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(tmr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
  tmr.TIP_TITLE AS tip_title,
  tmr.TIP_AUTHOR AS author,
  tmr.TIP_ISBN AS isbn,
  tmr.TERM_CODE AS library_term_code,
  CASE WHEN tmr.IN_LIBRARY_RESERVES = '1' THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS available_in_library,
  COALESCE(bic.instructors_per_library_book, 0) AS instructors_per_library_book,
  COALESCE(dlm.total_library_materials_per_department, 0) AS total_library_materials_per_department,
  COALESCE(ta.total_available_materials_all_departments, 0) AS total_available_materials_all_departments
FROM tip_material_records tmr
LEFT JOIN book_instructor_counts bic
  ON COALESCE(tmr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') = bic.department_name
  AND COALESCE(tmr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') = bic.department_code
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(tmr.TIP_ISBN,''), tmr.TIP_TITLE) = bic.book_identifier
LEFT JOIN dept_library_materials dlm
  ON COALESCE(tmr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') = dlm.department_name
  AND COALESCE(tmr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') = dlm.department_code
CROSS JOIN total_available ta
WHERE tmr.TIP_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR tmr.TIP_ISBN IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY department_name, tip_title

rows.question: In ascending order of construction start year, for each owned building that is not a subdivision, list the construction start year, the building number, and the year of initial occupancy. Display the construction start year only if it differs from the previous row. If the year of initial occupancy or construction start year is unknown, display 'UNKNOWN'. You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of owned buildings that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH owned AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    f.DATE_BUILT,
    f.DATE_OCCUPIED,
    f.BUILDING_NAME,
    f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM buildings b
  JOIN fclt_building f
    ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = f.BUILDING_NUMBER
  WHERE f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    -- exclude subdivisions by name/number containing 'SUBDIV' if no subdivision column exists
    AND NOT (
      UPPER(COALESCE(f.BUILDING_NAME,'') ) LIKE '%SUBDIV%' OR
      UPPER(COALESCE(f.BUILDING_NUMBER,'') ) LIKE '%SUBDIV%'
    )
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    -- extract 4-digit year from DATE_BUILT (mm/dd/YYYY) or other formats; NULL if missing/unparsable
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_BUILT) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(DATE_BUILT,'/',-1)
      WHEN DATE_BUILT REGEXP '[0-9]{4}$' THEN RIGHT(DATE_BUILT,4)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS construction_year,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_OCCUPIED) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(DATE_OCCUPIED,'/',-1)
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED REGEXP '[0-9]{4}$' THEN RIGHT(DATE_OCCUPIED,4)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS occupancy_year
  FROM owned
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    construction_year,
    occupancy_year,
    -- display values: show 'UNKNOWN' when NULL, otherwise the 4-digit year
    COALESCE(construction_year, 'UNKNOWN') AS construction_year_display,
    COALESCE(occupancy_year, 'UNKNOWN') AS occupancy_year_display,
    -- numeric year for ordering; NULL for 'UNKNOWN' (so UNKNOWN sorts after numeric years)
    CASE WHEN construction_year REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(construction_year AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS construction_year_num
  FROM parsed
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    construction_year_display,
    occupancy_year_display,
    construction_year_num
  FROM normalized
  ORDER BY
    -- place numeric years first ascending, NULLs (UNKNOWN) last
    (construction_year_num IS NULL), construction_year_num ASC, BUILDING_NUMBER ASC
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    construction_year_display,
    occupancy_year_display,
    construction_year_num,
    LAG(construction_year_display) OVER (ORDER BY (construction_year_num IS NULL), construction_year_num ASC, BUILDING_NUMBER ASC) AS prev_construction_year_display
  FROM ordered
),
detailed AS (
  SELECT
    -- show the construction year only when it differs from previous row; otherwise NULL
    CASE WHEN prev_construction_year_display = construction_year_display THEN NULL ELSE construction_year_display END AS construction_start_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    occupancy_year_display AS initial_occupancy_year,
    -- helper to keep ordering and to allow UNION ALL then final ordering
    (CASE WHEN construction_year_num IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_flag,
    construction_year_num
  FROM with_prev
),
summary_row AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS construction_start_year,
    CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
    NULL AS initial_occupancy_year,
    2 AS unknown_flag, -- ensure summary sorts after detail rows
    NULL AS construction_year_num
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM (
  SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year, unknown_flag, construction_year_num FROM detailed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year, unknown_flag, construction_year_num FROM summary_row
) t
ORDER BY
  -- put detail rows (unknown_flag 0 or 1) before summary (unknown_flag = 2)
  unknown_flag ASC,
  -- within detail rows, order by numeric year (NULLs last) then building_number
  CASE WHEN unknown_flag < 2 THEN construction_year_num ELSE NULL END,
  building_number

  AND NOT EXISTS (

WITH organizations AS (

    `fac_organization`.`ORGANIZATION_ID`        AS ORGANIZATION_ID,

    -- Treat ORGANIZATION_LEVEL as integer for padding logic

  )                                       AS FORMATTED_NAME,
  CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS ASSIGNABLE_FLAG,
  -- TOTAL_AREA rounded to nearest integer and formatted with commas; null preserved if no data
  CASE
    WHEN rab.TOTAL_AREA IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE FORMAT(ROUND(rab.TOTAL_AREA), 0)
  END                                       AS TOTAL_AREA,
  -- NUMBER_OF_ROOMS rounded (count is integer already) and formatted; null preserved
  CASE
    WHEN rab.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE FORMAT(ROUND(rab.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS), 0)
  END                                       AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  -- AVERAGE_ROOM_AREA = total area / number_of_rooms; handle division-by-zero/null
  CASE
    WHEN rab.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS IS NULL OR rab.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS = 0 OR rab.TOTAL_AREA IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE FORMAT(ROUND(rab.TOTAL_AREA / rab.NUMBER_OF_ROOMS), 0)
  END                                       AS AVERAGE_ROOM_AREA
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN room_areas_by_org rab
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = rab.ORGANIZATION_ID
WHERE COALESCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'
ORDER BY o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER

rows.question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. Include subtotals for each building and a grand total across all buildings. The subtotals and grand total should not include zip code or city. Numbers of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dept_org AS (
  SELECT `ORGANIZATION_KEY`
  FROM `fac_organization`
  WHERE `ORGANIZATION_NAME` = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
),
room_agg_floor AS (
  SELECT
    r.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    r.`FCLT_FLOOR_KEY` AS floor_key,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.`AREA`,0)) AS total_area
  FROM `fclt_rooms` r
  WHERE r.`FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY` IN (SELECT `ORGANIZATION_KEY` FROM dept_org)
    AND r.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
    AND r.`FCLT_FLOOR_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`, r.`FCLT_FLOOR_KEY`
),
building_ref AS (
  SELECT
    b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS fac_building_key,
    b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key_by_fac,
    b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS building_number,
    b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS building_name,
    b.`ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME` AS access_level,
    -- ZIP_CODE and CITY are not present in schema; keep NULL placeholders
    NULL AS zip_code,
    NULL AS city
  FROM `fac_building` b
),
building_stats AS (
  SELECT
    raf.building_key,
    raf.floor_key,
    raf.number_of_rooms,
    raf.total_area,
    br.building_name,
    br.access_level,
    br.zip_code,
    br.city
  FROM room_agg_floor raf
  LEFT JOIN building_ref br
    ON (br.fac_building_key = raf.building_key OR br.building_number = raf.building_key)
),
per_floor_rows AS (
  SELECT
    bs.building_key,
    bs.floor_key,
    bs.number_of_rooms,
    bs.total_area,
    bs.building_name,
    bs.access_level,
    bs.zip_code,
    bs.city,
    -- helpers for ordering and later calculations
    bs.building_name AS ordering_building_name
  FROM building_stats bs
),
per_building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    building_key,
    NULL AS floor_key,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    MAX(building_name) AS building_name,
    NULL AS access_level,        -- subtotal rows should not include access level per requirements
    NULL AS zip_code,
    NULL AS city,
    MAX(ordering_building_name) AS ordering_building_name,
    COUNT(*) AS floors_count
  FROM per_floor_rows
  GROUP BY building_key
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'GRAND_TOTAL' AS building_key,
    NULL AS floor_key,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    NULL AS building_name,
    NULL AS access_level,
    NULL AS zip_code,
    NULL AS city,
    NULL AS ordering_building_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(floors_count),0) AS floors_count
  FROM per_building_totals
),
combined AS (
  -- detail rows
  SELECT
    'detail' AS row_type,
    pfr.building_key,
    pfr.floor_key,
    pfr.number_of_rooms,
    pfr.total_area,
    pfr.building_name,
    pfr.access_level,
    pfr.zip_code,
    pfr.city,
    pfr.ordering_building_name,
    NULL AS floors_count
  FROM per_floor_rows pfr

  UNION ALL

  -- subtotal rows per building
  SELECT
    'subtotal' AS row_type,
    pbt.building_key,
    NULL AS floor_key,
    pbt.number_of_rooms,
    pbt.total_area,
    pbt.building_name,
    pbt.access_level,
    pbt.zip_code,
    pbt.city,
    pbt.ordering_building_name,
    pbt.floors_count
  FROM per_building_totals pbt

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total row
  SELECT
    'grand_total' AS row_type,
    gt.building_key,
    NULL AS floor_key,
    gt.number_of_rooms,
    gt.total_area,
    gt.building_name,
    gt.access_level,
    gt.zip_code,
    gt.city,
    gt.ordering_building_name,
    gt.floors_count
  FROM grand_total gt
)
SELECT
  row_type AS ROW_TYPE,
  building_key AS BUILDING_KEY,
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'detail' THEN floor_key ELSE NULL END AS FLOOR_KEY,
  -- formatted numbers: round to integer and format with commas
  FORMAT(ROUND(number_of_rooms),0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_area),0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  -- AVG_AREA_PER_FLOOR:
  -- For detail and subtotal rows show building's average area per floor (total_area for building / number of floors for that building).
  -- For detail rows we need the building-level average; use a correlated subquery over per_building_totals.
  CASE
    WHEN row_type = 'grand_total' THEN
      -- grand total average area per floor across all buildings:
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          COALESCE(
            (SELECT SUM(total_area) FROM per_building_totals),
            0
          )
          /
          NULLIF(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(floors_count) FROM per_building_totals),0),0)
        ,0)
      ,0)
    WHEN row_type IN ('detail','subtotal') THEN
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          COALESCE(
            (SELECT pbt.total_area FROM per_building_totals pbt WHERE pbt.building_key = combined.building_key),
            0
          )
          /
          NULLIF(
            COALESCE(
              (SELECT pbt.floors_count FROM per_building_totals pbt WHERE pbt.building_key = combined.building_key),
              0
            ),0)
        ,0)
      ,0)
    ELSE ''
  END AS AVG_AREA_PER_FLOOR,
  -- BUILDING_NAME: for grand_total show NULL/empty
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'grand_total' THEN NULL ELSE building_name END AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- ACCESS_LEVEL: only for detail rows per requirements; subtotal and grand_total should be null/empty
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'detail' THEN access_level ELSE NULL END AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  -- ZIP_CODE and CITY only for detail rows
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'detail' THEN zip_code ELSE NULL END AS ZIP_CODE,
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'detail' THEN city ELSE NULL END AS CITY
FROM combined
ORDER BY
  -- order buildings by BUILDING_NAME ascending (nulls last), then details (floors) ascending, then subtotal, and grand total last
  CASE WHEN building_name IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  ordering_building_name ASC,
  CASE row_type WHEN 'detail' THEN 1 WHEN 'subtotal' THEN 2 WHEN 'grand_total' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  -- for detail rows, order by floor_key; put NULLs last
  CASE WHEN row_type = 'detail' THEN floor_key ELSE NULL END ASC

rows.question: For each course in the current term, list the department, school, course number, subject title, total number of enrolled students, term code, and count of distinct catalog ISBNs. Add a summary row at the bottom showing the total number of students and distinct catalog ISBNs for the current term in the format of ('TOTAL:', null, null, null, total number of students, null, number of distinct catalog ISBNs).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH current_academic_terms AS (
  SELECT TERM_CODE
  FROM academic_terms
  WHERE IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
),
offerings_in_current_term AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_KEY,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    so.COURSE_NUMBER,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    so.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN current_academic_terms cat
    ON so.TERM_CODE = cat.TERM_CODE
),
catalog_meta AS (
  -- use course_catalog_subject_offered for authoritative SUBJECT_NUMBER, TITLE, DEPARTMENT_CODE/NAME when available
  SELECT
    cc.TERM_CODE,
    cc.SUBJECT_ID,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    cc.SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc
  JOIN current_academic_terms cat ON cc.TERM_CODE = cat.TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cm.DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COALESCE(cm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(cm.SUBJECT_NUMBER, o.COURSE_NUMBER) AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(cm.SUBJECT_TITLE, o.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  SUM(o.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED,
  o.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.ISBN) AS DISTINCT_CATALOG_ISBNS
FROM offerings_in_current_term o
LEFT JOIN catalog_meta cm
  ON cm.TERM_CODE = o.TERM_CODE
  AND cm.SUBJECT_ID = o.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.TERM_CODE = o.TERM_CODE
  AND td.SUBJECT_ID = o.SUBJECT_ID
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(cm.DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.OFFER_DEPT_CODE),
  COALESCE(cm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL),
  COALESCE(cm.SUBJECT_NUMBER, o.COURSE_NUMBER),
  COALESCE(cm.SUBJECT_TITLE, o.SUBJECT_TITLE),
  o.TERM_CODE

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL:' AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  SUM(o.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED,
  NULL AS TERM_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.ISBN) AS DISTINCT_CATALOG_ISBNS
FROM offerings_in_current_term o
LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.TERM_CODE = o.TERM_CODE
  AND td.SUBJECT_ID = o.SUBJECT_ID

ORDER BY
  -- ensure the TOTAL: row comes last by sorting DEPARTMENT_CODE ascending but treating 'TOTAL:' as highest
  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE = 'TOTAL:' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE ASC,
  SUBJECT_NUMBER ASC

rows.question: For each IAP category, list its name, number of unique sessions, total number of attendees, active period (in the format of 'beginning term code-end term code'), the most common sponsor name, and the most common session start time. Include a grand total row showing the total number of sessions and attendees across all categories in the format of ('TOTAL', number of sessions, number of attendees, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_category_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY` AS SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
    `IAP_CATEGORY_NAME` AS CATEGORY_NAME
  FROM iap_subject_category
),
iap_sessions_base AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY        AS SECTION_ID,
    dd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY      AS SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
    dd.TERM_CODE                     AS TERM_CODE,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME                  AS SPONSOR_NAME,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME             AS START_TIME,
    -- ATTENDANCE in detail appears to be the attendee count stored as text; cast to signed, treat empty as NULL
    CAST(NULLIF(dd.ATTENDANCE, '') AS SIGNED)    AS ATTENDEES
  FROM iap_subject_session AS s
  JOIN iap_subject_detail  AS dd
    ON dd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_sponsor AS sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = dd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
),
per_category AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SECTION_ID) AS unique_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(ATTENDEES, 0)) AS total_attendees,
    MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term,
    MAX(TERM_CODE) AS max_term
  FROM iap_sessions_base
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID
),
most_common_sponsor AS (
  -- pick the sponsor name with highest frequency per category; tie-break by sponsor name ascending
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY cnt DESC, SPONSOR_NAME ASC SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS most_common_sponsor
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
      SPONSOR_NAME,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM iap_sessions_base
    WHERE SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SPONSOR_NAME <> ''
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID, SPONSOR_NAME
  ) t
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID
),
most_common_start_time AS (
  -- pick the start time with highest frequency per category; tie-break by start time ascending
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(START_TIME ORDER BY cnt DESC, START_TIME ASC SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS most_common_start_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID,
      START_TIME,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM iap_sessions_base
    WHERE START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND START_TIME <> ''
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID, START_TIME
  ) t
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID
),
grand_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SECTION_ID) AS unique_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(ATTENDEES, 0)) AS total_attendees
  FROM iap_sessions_base
)
SELECT
  c.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  COALESCE(p.unique_sessions, 0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(p.total_attendees, 0) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  CASE
    WHEN p.min_term IS NULL AND p.max_term IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CONCAT(p.min_term, '-', p.max_term)
  END AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  mcs.most_common_sponsor AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  mcst.most_common_start_time AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM iap_category_dim c
LEFT JOIN per_category p
  ON c.SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID = p.SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID
LEFT JOIN most_common_sponsor mcs
  ON c.SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID = mcs.SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID
LEFT JOIN most_common_start_time mcst
  ON c.SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID = mcst.SUBJECT_CATEGORY_ID

UNION ALL

SELECT
  category_name AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  unique_sessions AS NUM_UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
  total_attendees AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  NULL AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  NULL AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  NULL AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM grand_totals

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN CATEGORY_NAME = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CATEGORY_NAME

rows.question: For each building type, list the name of the building type, the number of buildings that are not subdivisions, number of employees, number of unique building street address, number of unique city, number of unique state, number of unique postal code, and average gross square footage per employee. For building type of 'resident', display it as 'RESIDENTIAL'. Include a grand total across all building types (the corresponding type field is 'TOTAL').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_canonical_addresses AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fba.STREET_NUMBER AS ADDRESS_LINE1,
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '' AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END
    ) AS ADDRESS_LINE2,
    fba.CITY AS CITY,
    fba.STATE AS STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
    fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE
  FROM fclt_building b
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba
    ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    AND (fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE IS NULL OR fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'PRIMARY' OR fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET')
),
building_base_rows AS (
  SELECT
    bd.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_ID,
    bd.BUILDING_TYPE AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    CASE
      WHEN bd.BUILDING_NAME REGEXP '[[:<:]](annex|annx|wing|unit|suite|ste|subdivision|subdiv|blk|block|lot|apt|apartment)[[:>:]]' THEN 1
      WHEN bd.BUILDING_NUMBER REGEXP '[-/]?(A|B|C|D|E|F|G|H|I|II|III|IV)$' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS IS_SUBDIVISION,
    bd.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    addr.CITY AS CITY,
    addr.STATE AS STATE,
    addr.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
    CASE WHEN addr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(addr.ADDRESS_LINE1,''),' ',COALESCE(addr.ADDRESS_LINE2,'')) ELSE NULL END AS STREET_ADDRESS
  FROM buildings bd
  LEFT JOIN building_canonical_addresses addr
    ON addr.BUILDING_KEY = bd.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE
    NOT (
      bd.BUILDING_NAME REGEXP '[[:<:]](annex|annx|wing|unit|suite|ste|subdivision|subdiv|blk|block|lot|apt|apartment)[[:>:]]'
      OR bd.BUILDING_NUMBER REGEXP '[-/]?(A|B|C|D|E|F|G|H|I|II|III|IV)$'
    )
),
employee_counts AS (
  SELECT
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    COUNT(*) AS emp_count
  FROM employee_directory
  WHERE OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_LOCATION <> ''
  GROUP BY OFFICE_LOCATION
),
per_type AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN UPPER(bbr.BUILDING_TYPE) = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE COALESCE(bbr.BUILDING_TYPE,'UNKNOWN') END AS building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bbr.BUILDING_ID) AS non_subdivision_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ec.emp_count),0) AS employees_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bbr.STREET_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL THEN bbr.STREET_ADDRESS END) AS unique_street_address_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bbr.CITY) AS unique_city_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bbr.STATE) AS unique_state_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bbr.POSTAL_CODE) AS unique_postal_code_count,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ec.emp_count) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(COALESCE(bbr.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0)) / SUM(ec.emp_count)
    END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
  FROM building_base_rows bbr
  LEFT JOIN employee_counts ec
    ON ec.OFFICE_LOCATION = bbr.BUILDING_ID
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN UPPER(bbr.BUILDING_TYPE) = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE COALESCE(bbr.BUILDING_TYPE,'UNKNOWN') END
)
SELECT
  building_type,
  non_subdivision_count,
  employees_count,
  unique_street_address_count,
  unique_city_count,
  unique_state_count,
  unique_postal_code_count,
  avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM per_type

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_type,
  SUM(non_subdivision_count) AS non_subdivision_count,
  SUM(employees_count) AS employees_count,
  SUM(unique_street_address_count) AS unique_street_address_count,
  SUM(unique_city_count) AS unique_city_count,
  SUM(unique_state_count) AS unique_state_count,
  SUM(unique_postal_code_count) AS unique_postal_code_count,
  CASE WHEN SUM(employees_count) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(
         CASE WHEN avg_gross_sqft_per_employee IS NULL THEN 0
              ELSE avg_gross_sqft_per_employee * employees_count
         END
       ) / SUM(employees_count)
  END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM per_type

rows.question: List each organization's break group, ID, name, and formatted name according to its level, along with whether its members are emeritus or non-emeritus. Also, include the organization number, level, employer count, and hierarchy type for each organization. Exclude organizations '139' and '250'. Sort the results by hierarchy type and ensure totals for employer counts are displayed.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH person_employer_status AS (
  SELECT
    opa.MIT_ID AS PERSON_ID,
    opa.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS EMPLOYER_ORG_ID,
    -- Use EMERITUS_STATUS from hr_faculty_roster when available (joined below),
    -- otherwise default to 'Non-Emeritus'. Keep PERSON_ID for counting.
    NULL AS EMERITUS_STATUS
  FROM opa_person_current opa
),
organization_employer_counts AS (
  -- Build mapping of person -> employer org and emeritus flag.
  SELECT
    opc.MIT_ID AS PERSON_ID,
    opc.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS EMPLOYER_ORG_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN hrf.EMERITUS_STATUS = 'Emeritus' THEN 'Emeritus'
      ELSE 'Non-Emeritus'
    END AS EMERITUS_STATUS
  FROM opa_person_current opc
  LEFT JOIN hr_faculty_roster hrf
    ON opc.MIT_ID = hrf.MIT_ID
),
organizations_core AS (
  SELECT
    fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORG_ID,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fo.ORGANIZATION AS ORGANIZATION_SHORT,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS ORG_LEVEL,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS ORG_NUMBER,
    -- BREAK_GROUP: prefer ORGANIZATION_SORT (if present) else ORGANIZATION_NUMBER
    COALESCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS BREAK_GROUP,
    -- HIERARCHY_TYPE: simple derived classification
    CASE
      WHEN fo.MAJOR_ORG IS NOT NULL AND fo.MAJOR_ORG <> '' THEN 'MAJOR'
      WHEN fo.ORG_PARENT IS NOT NULL AND fo.ORG_PARENT <> '' THEN 'SUB'
      ELSE 'ROOT'
    END AS HIERARCHY_TYPE,
    -- FORMATTED_NAME_BY_LEVEL: format name based on level: prefer ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    -- fallback to ORGANIZATION; include level in formatting for clarity if present.
    TRIM(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fo.ORGANIZATION, ''))
    ) AS FORMATTED_NAME_BY_LEVEL
  FROM fac_organization fo
)
SELECT
  oc.BREAK_GROUP AS BREAK_GROUP,
  oc.ORG_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  oc.FORMATTED_NAME_BY_LEVEL AS FORMATTED_NAME_BY_LEVEL,
  -- Emeritus category (explicitly shown as 'Emeritus' or 'Non-Emeritus')
  ecs.EMERITUS_STATUS AS EMERITUS_STATUS_CATEGORY,
  oc.ORG_NUMBER AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  oc.ORG_LEVEL AS LEVEL,
  -- Count distinct persons per organization per emeritus category.
  COUNT(DISTINCT ecs.PERSON_ID) AS EMPLOYER_COUNT,
  oc.HIERARCHY_TYPE AS HIERARCHY_TYPE
FROM organizations_core oc
-- left join counts so organizations with zero members still appear (with count 0)
LEFT JOIN organization_employer_counts ecs
  ON ecs.EMPLOYER_ORG_ID = oc.ORG_ID
WHERE oc.ORG_ID NOT IN ('139', '250')
GROUP BY
  oc.BREAK_GROUP,
  oc.ORG_ID,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  oc.FORMATTED_NAME_BY_LEVEL,
